canonicalSections.heading: Exit Trigger Rule
canonicalSections.body:
Exit trigger 必须回答：

```
WHAT CHANGED?
WHY DOES IT MATTER?
WHICH CONDITION IS NOW VIOLATED?
```

不能只写：

```
if things feel bad
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Trigger Classes
canonicalSections.body:
建议至少支持：

```
DATE_TRIGGER
STATE_TRIGGER
THRESHOLD_TRIGGER
EVENT_TRIGGER
AUTHORITY_TRIGGER
MINIMUM_STATE_TRIGGER
```

例如：

```
DATE_TRIGGER:
review after 6 months

STATE_TRIGGER:
no viable clients

THRESHOLD_TRIGGER:
liquidity falls below confirmed floor

EVENT_TRIGGER:
key contract terminates

AUTHORITY_TRIGGER:
professional review requires pause
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Early Exit Rule
canonicalSections.body:
有时较早退出虽然：

```
realizes loss sooner
```

却保留更多：

```
recovery capacity
optionality
liquidity
time
```

Navigation 应让这种结构可见。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Late Exit Rule
canonicalSections.body:
如果继续等待会使：

```
recovery resource shrink
```

应标记：

```
LATE_EXIT_RISK
```

这直接连接 NAV-18 Waiting Cost。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Exit Cost Rule
canonicalSections.body:
每个 exit route 必须尽量包括：

```
financial cost
time cost
legal cost
relationship cost
operational cost
residual effect
```

不能只说：

```
you can always leave
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Recovery Target Rule
canonicalSections.body:
恢复目标不必是：

```
original state
```

可以是：

```
MINIMUM_ACCEPTABLE_RECOVERED_STATE
```

例如：

```
stable housing
basic income
6 months liquidity
employment re-entry
family care continuity
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Recovery Time Rule
canonicalSections.body:
恢复不仅需要资源，也需要时间。

例如：

```
job re-entry
```

可能需要：

```
3–6 months
```

如果这个范围有现实依据，应纳入。

若无依据：

```
RECOVERY_TIME_UNKNOWN
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Recovery Dependency Rule
canonicalSections.body:
恢复可能依赖：

```
market conditions
professional licence
support network
partner cooperation
available employer
cash buffer
```

这些依赖不能隐藏。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Recovery Capacity Rule
canonicalSections.body:
执行方案前应尽量检查：

```
post-failure capacity
```

而不是只检查：

```
entry capacity
```

一个方案如果需要耗尽全部资源才能进入，可能根本没有 recovery capacity。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Recovery Preservation Rule
canonicalSections.body:
为了保留恢复能力，有时应该在成功阶段也持续保留：

```
emergency reserve
professional network
credentials
insurance
backup supplier
secondary income source
```

但是否需要这些，应与具体方案相关。

---

canonicalSections.heading: No Infinite Rescue Rule
canonicalSections.body:
不能为了让方案看起来可恢复而无限添加假设：

```
family can lend
bank can lend
old employer will rehire
market will improve
```

如果没有支持，应保留：

```
RECOVERY_DEPENDENCY_UNCONFIRMED
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Recovery vs Sunk Cost Rule
canonicalSections.body:
一旦 exit trigger 达到，过去投入不能自动成为继续理由。

冻结：

> **The resources already spent do not revoke an exit route that was established precisely to prevent deeper loss.**

中文：

> **已经投入的资源，不能在退出条件真正触发以后，反过来取消原本就是为了防止更大损失而建立的退出路线。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: Exit Trigger Drift Rule
canonicalSections.body:
用户可能在现实中不断把 trigger 往后移。

例如：

```
original:
exit at 6 months no traction

later:
wait 3 more months

later:
one more quarter
```

系统应标记：

```
EXIT_TRIGGER_DRIFT
```

但不能道德化。

需要问：

> 新证据是否真的使原 trigger 失效？

---

canonicalSections.heading: Partial Exit Rule
canonicalSections.body:
退出不一定是：

```
ALL OR NOTHING
```

可能包括：

```
reduce exposure
reduce hours
sell part
pause
stop one product
leave one market
end one commitment
```

这使 Exit Route 与 NAV-10 Response Level、NAV-17 Structural Alternative 连接。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Recovery Route Hierarchy
canonicalSections.body:
可以区分：

```
R1_STABILIZE
R2_RESTORE_MINIMUM
R3_REBUILD_CAPACITY
R4_REOPEN_OPTION_SPACE
```

例如：

```
Stabilize:
stop cash burn

Restore minimum:
secure essential income

Rebuild:
rebuild 6-month buffer

Reopen:
consider new career direction again
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Other-People Rule
canonicalSections.body:
如果 Exit / Recovery 会影响：

```
partner
children
dependants
employees
co-owner
```

必须读取 NAV-08。

用户不能单方面把：

```
others absorb recovery cost
```

当成默认 recovery plan。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Professional Boundary Rule
canonicalSections.body:
在：

```
medical
legal
regulated financial
estate
```

领域，Exit / Recovery Route 可能需要专业 authority。

Navigation 只能组织，不得冒充专业程序。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Scenario-to-Trigger Rule
canonicalSections.body:
NAV-24 的 Downside 不自动等于 Exit Trigger。

正确关系：

```
Downside Scenario
↓
Observe actual condition
↓
Trigger threshold reached?
↓
Exit / Recovery action
```

Scenario 仍然只是条件路径。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Customer Projection Example
canonicalSections.body:
内部：

```
Option:
Independent consulting

Exit Trigger:
usable liquidity reaches 8 months
AND
qualified client pipeline remains below confirmed minimum

Exit Route:
stop expansion spend
return to active employment search
maintain current clients during transition

Recovery Minimum:
household essentials covered
health coverage maintained
6 months liquidity preserved

Recovery Route:
employment re-entry
+
retain consulting as secondary income
```

客户可以看到：

> **真正让这条路更可承担的，不是保证它一定成功，而是你已经知道如果它没有按预期发展，什么时候停止继续下注，以及停止以后怎样回来。**
> 
> 目前可以把一个关键复核点放在现金缓冲与客户进展之间：如果可用流动性下降到已经确认的边界，而稳定客户仍没有形成，就不再继续扩大投入，而是停止新增扩张成本，重新启动正式求职，同时保留已经能够产生收入的客户。这样做并不能消除失败的可能，却可以避免为了证明自己“再坚持一下”而把恢复所需的资源也一起耗尽。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Customer Actions
canonicalSections.body:
允许：

```
Confirm exit trigger
Change trigger
Add exit route
Add recovery route
Set recovery minimum
Add professional review
Reduce option scale
Mark dependency unknown
Continue
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: `status`
canonicalSections.body:
建议：

```
UNFORMED
PARTIAL
EXIT_ROUTE_READY
EXIT_ROUTE_WITH_COST
EXIT_ROUTE_UNKNOWN
RECOVERY_ROUTE_READY
RECOVERY_ROUTE_PARTIAL
RECOVERY_CAPACITY_INSUFFICIENT
TRIGGER_PENDING_CONFIRMATION
READY_FOR_DECISION_SUFFICIENCY
REOPENED
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Fail-Closed Conditions
canonicalSections.body:
以下情况不得进入 NAV-26：

```
criticalExitTriggerUnknown
exitRouteInvented
recoveryCapacityFabricated
minimumStateNotConnected
contractOrLegalExitAssumed
thirdPartySupportAssumedWithoutConsent
symbolicReadingUsedAsExitAuthority
scenarioTreatedAsActualTrigger
recoveryDependencyHidden
decisionObjectChanged
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Canonical Runtime Rule
canonicalSections.body:
> **Navigation must define how a high-impact option can be exited and how a minimum acceptable state can be recovered before treating the option as ready for final sufficiency review.**

中文：

> **Navigation 在把一个高影响选项送入最终充分性判断以前，必须先明确它怎样退出，以及最低可接受状态怎样恢复。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: Canonical Exit Rule
canonicalSections.body:
> **An exit route is not a prediction of failure; it is a boundary against allowing failure to consume the resources needed for recovery.**

中文：

> **退出路线不是对失败的预测，而是一条边界，用来防止失败继续吞噬本来应该留给恢复的资源。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: Canonical Recovery Rule
canonicalSections.body:
> **Recovery does not require restoring the past; it requires returning to a state from which meaningful choice becomes possible again.**

中文：

> **恢复并不要求回到过去原样，而是回到一个重新拥有真实选择能力的状态。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: Canonical Trigger Rule
canonicalSections.body:
> **An exit trigger must be tied to observable conditions, confirmed thresholds, or legitimate authority—not fear, symbolic interpretation, or retrospective regret alone.**

中文：

> **退出触发条件必须建立在可观察现实、已经确认的门槛或合法权威上，而不能只建立在恐惧、象征解释或事后后悔上。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: Canonical Preservation Rule
canonicalSections.body:
> **A strong exit design preserves enough capacity, value, and option space that a failed path does not become an unrecoverable life structure.**

中文：

> **好的退出设计，是在一条路径失败时仍然保留足够的容量、价值与选择空间，使一次失败不会被放大成无法恢复的生活结构。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: Final Canonical Form
canonicalSections.body:
```
NAV-25
EXIT / RECOVERY ROUTE
```

**Input**

```
Candidate Option
+
Baseline / Upside / Downside
+
Minimum Acceptable State
+
Reversibility
+
Available Recovery Capacity
```

**Process**

```
Determine:
When Would We Stop?
How Can We Exit?
What Will Exit Cost?
What Must Still Remain?
How Do We Recover?
What Reopens Choice?
```

**Output**

```
Exit Trigger Set
+
Exit Route
+
Recovery Route
+
Recovery Readiness State
```

**Boundary**

```
Exit is not failure prediction.
Recovery is not restoration.
A route is only real if its conditions actually exist.
```

modules.canonicalText:
# NAV-25｜Exit / Recovery Route

## 退出与恢复路径｜失败以后，我们还能去哪里

**Canonical Question｜规范问题**

> **为什么一个方案在进入以前，就必须先知道：如果现实没有按预期发展，我们怎样退出、怎样恢复，以及恢复到什么状态？**

---

## 1. `moduleId`

```
NAV-25
```

## 2. `canonicalTitleZh`

```
退出与恢复路径
```

## 3. `canonicalTitleEn`

```
Exit / Recovery Route
```

## 4. `canonicalQuestion`

```
为什么一个方案在进入以前，就必须先知道：
如果现实没有按预期发展，我们怎样退出、怎样恢复，以及恢复到什么状态？
```

---

# 5. `definition`

**Exit / Recovery Route** 是 Navigation 对“方案进入现实以后，如果结果低于预期、接近最低可接受状态，或关键假设失效，系统能够怎样停止、缩小、撤回、转向，并重新回到一个可承担状态”进行正式设计的机制。

它不等于：

```
PLAN B
```

也不只是：

```
emergency backup
```

更不是悲观地假定：

> “这个方案会失败。”

它真正回答的是：

> **如果这个决定后来被现实证明不再值得继续，我们是否提前知道怎样离开，而不是等到已经失去大部分选择以后才开始寻找出口？**

例如，一个人准备：

```
离职后做独立顾问
```

真正成熟的 Navigation 不只应该知道：

```
什么时候开始
需要多少资金
可能获得什么
```

还应该提前知道：

```
什么情况下停止继续烧现金
什么情况下开始重新求职
最低还需要保留多少流动性
哪些客户收入不足以继续支撑
恢复就业需要准备什么
家庭支出怎样维持
```

因此：

> **NAV-25 的核心不是替失败做准备，而是确保一个决定即使失败，也不会因为没有出口而把失败放大成无法恢复的失控。**

---

# 6. `navigationMeaning`

NAV-06 已经回答：

```
这个决定能不能回头？
```

NAV-22 已经回答：

```
最差还能接受到哪里？
```

NAV-24 已经回答：

```
在基线、上行、下行情景中，
这个方案分别会怎样？
```

NAV-25 进一步把这些内容变成：

```
If X happens
→ what do we do next?
```

因此它建立：

```
Downside Scenario
+
Minimum Acceptable State
+
Reversibility Profile
↓
Exit Trigger
↓
Exit Route
↓
Recovery Route
↓
Recovered State
```

这使 Navigation 从：

```
understanding risk
```

进入：

```
designing survivability
```

---

# 7. `requiredInputs`

NAV-25 最低需要：

```
candidateOption
baselineUpsideDownsideSet
minimumAcceptableState
reversibilityProfile
currentPosition
capacityQualificationState
```

并必须至少知道：

```
what would make the option no longer qualified
what resources remain available if that happens
```

如果这些仍然未知，应保留：

```
EXIT_ROUTE_UNDEFINED
RECOVERY_ROUTE_UNDEFINED
```

---

# 8. `optionalInputs`

```
financialNavigationProjection
currentRealityProjection
professionalInput
legalOrContractualContext
relationshipContext
careContext
structuralAlternativeState
waitingQualificationState
priorNavigationState
```

这些用于判断：

- 哪些退出是现实可行；
- 哪些退出存在合同或法律成本；
- 恢复需要多少时间；
- 哪些条件不能等到触发时才处理。

---

# 9. `inputAuthorityClasses`

允许：

```
CURRENT_FACT
FINANCIAL_RECORD
CONTRACTUAL_RECORD
LEGAL_REQUIREMENT
PROFESSIONAL_INPUT
USER_CONFIRMED_TRIGGER
SUPPORTED_PROJECTION
SCENARIO_ASSUMPTION
INTERPRETIVE_CONTEXT
UNKNOWN
```

但真正的：

```
EXIT_RIGHT
EXIT_COST
RECOVERY_REQUIREMENT
```

不能只依赖解释性来源。

---

# 10. Core Exit / Recovery States

建议至少区分：

```
EXIT_ROUTE_READY
EXIT_ROUTE_AVAILABLE_WITH_COST
EXIT_ROUTE_CONDITIONALLY_AVAILABLE
EXIT_ROUTE_UNKNOWN
RECOVERY_ROUTE_READY
RECOVERY_ROUTE_PARTIAL
RECOVERY_ROUTE_UNDEFINED
RECOVERY_CAPACITY_INSUFFICIENT
```

---

## A. `EXIT_ROUTE_READY`

已明确：

```
when to exit
how to exit
what it costs
what remains afterward
```

---

## B. `EXIT_ROUTE_AVAILABLE_WITH_COST`

可以退出，但需要承担：

```
financial penalty
notice period
downtime
relationship disruption
legal process
```

---

## C. `EXIT_ROUTE_CONDITIONALLY_AVAILABLE`

退出只有在某些条件成立时可行。

例如：

```
buyer exists
replacement role secured
consent obtained
minimum liquidity maintained
```

---

## D. `EXIT_ROUTE_UNKNOWN`

系统不知道怎样退出。

高影响、低可逆方案如果出现这一状态，需要提高执行门槛。

---

## E. `RECOVERY_ROUTE_READY`

已经知道失败以后怎样回到：

```
minimum acceptable state
```

或更高状态。

---

## F. `RECOVERY_ROUTE_PARTIAL`

知道部分恢复方式，但关键部分仍缺失。

---

## G. `RECOVERY_CAPACITY_INSUFFICIENT`

即使退出，也没有足够资源支撑恢复。

这对 Decision Sufficiency 非常重要。

---

# 11. Exit ≠ Recovery

必须严格区分：

```
EXIT
```

与：

```
RECOVERY
```

例如：

```
关闭一家业务
```

是 Exit。

但：

```
重新建立收入
偿还剩余债务
恢复现金缓冲
重新进入就业
```

才是 Recovery。

因此：

> **能退出，并不等于退出以后能恢复。**

---

# 12. `allowedInference`

NAV-25 可以：

## A. 从 Downside Scenario 建立退出触发点

例如：

```
usable liquidity falls below 8 months
```

如果用户确认这会使方案不再值得继续，则可以建立：

```
EXIT_TRIGGER
```

---

## B. 从 NAV-22 建立 recovery floor

例如：

```
minimum acceptable liquidity = 6 months
```

则 Recovery Route 至少需要避免跌破该状态。

---

## C. 识别“退出太晚”会损害恢复能力

例如：

```
continue until liquidity nearly zero
```

可能意味着：

```
exit still possible
recovery much harder
```

因此可以标记：

```
LATE_EXIT_RISK
```

---

## D. 识别较早退出是否保留更多 future option

例如：

```
leave pilot after 3 months
```

可能比：

```
continue for 18 months
```

保留更多：

```
capital
time
career mobility
```

---

## E. 识别退出路线需要事先准备

例如：

```
maintain CV
keep licences active
preserve professional network
maintain emergency liquidity
```

这些可以属于：

```
RECOVERY_PREPARATION
```

---

# 13. `forbiddenInference`

NAV-25 严禁：

## A. 把任何 downside 自动变成 exit trigger

不是每个坏结果都意味着退出。

---

## B. 把 exit plan 当失败预言

```
exit route exists
≠
failure expected
```

---

## C. 用 Method Reading 决定什么时候退出

禁止：

```
Tarot says stop
→ EXIT_TRIGGER
```

---

## D. 用未经确认的数字建立 trigger

例如：

```
cash falls below RM30k
```

必须有合法来源。

---

## E. 假装退出以后一定可以恢复

恢复仍可能失败。

---

## F. 把恢复定义成完全回到过去

```
recovery
≠
restoration to original state
```

---

# 14. `decisionEffect`

NAV-25 主要影响：

```
OPTION_ELIGIBILITY
DECISION_THRESHOLD
ACTION_SCALE
CONTINGENCY_REQUIREMENT
RECOVERY_READINESS
EXIT_READINESS
```

核心 effect：

```
SURVIVABILITY
```

---

# 15. `decisionThresholdEffect`

冻结：

> **The weaker the exit route and recovery capacity, the stronger the decision sufficiency required before entering a high-impact option.**

中文：

> **一个高影响方案的退出路线越弱、恢复能力越低，真正进入行动以前所需要的决策充分程度就越高。**

如果：

```
LOW REVERSIBILITY
+
DOWN_SIDE_NEAR_MINIMUM
+
RECOVERY_ROUTE_UNDEFINED
```

则通常应产生：

```
HIGH_THRESHOLD
or
OPTION_REDESIGN_REQUIRED
```

---

# 16. `authorityBoundary`

NAV-25 可以：

- 建立 exit trigger；
- 设计 exit route；
- 设计 recovery route；
- 明确恢复所需资源；
- 识别 late exit risk；
- 建立 contingency preparation。

NAV-25 不可以：

- 自动替用户退出；
- 自动卖资产；
- 自动辞职；
- 自动终止关系；
- 绕过合同、法律、专业或 consent；
- 把所有失败想象都变成 trigger。

---

# 17. `humanDecisionBoundary`

用户必须确认：

```
什么情况下我愿意停止？
什么损失我愿意接受？
什么恢复状态对我来说已经足够？
```

系统可以提出：

> 如果独立业务连续六个月仍无法覆盖基本支出，你是否会启动退出？

但不能自行记录：

```
6 months = exit
```

除非用户确认或存在其他合法 authority。

---

# 18. `sourceSections`

主要来源：

```
Book VIII
15.38｜退出路径必须在进入以前被看见
15.40｜失败以后还能去哪里
```

相关：

```
15.35｜坏情况必须能够被承担
15.36｜哪些变量真正改变结果
15.37｜延迟也是一条路径
15.39｜路径之间怎样比较
```

并直接消费：

```
NAV-06 Reversibility
NAV-22 Minimum Acceptable State
NAV-24 Baseline / Upside / Downside
```

---

# 19. `relatedBookFoundations`

## Book III｜Reality Continuity

Book III 拥有：

```
recovery
continuity restoration
post-disruption viability
```

NAV-25 不重新解释恢复机制。

它只问：

> **这个具体决定一旦出错，我们有没有现实路径重新回到可承担状态？**

---

## Book VII｜Reality Observation

提供：

```
uncertainty
outcome observation
revision authority
```

尤其支持：

> **现实一旦证明原假设不成立，Navigation 必须允许方案失去继续资格。**

---

# 20. `profileConsumer`

Profile 可以帮助理解：

```
attachment to persistence
difficulty exiting
risk tolerance
identity dependence
```

但只能作为：

```
EXIT_BEHAVIOR_CONTEXT
```

不能决定：

```
EXIT_TRIGGER
```

---

# 21. `financialConsumer`

Financial 是 NAV-25 的核心 producer。

可提供：

```
remaining liquidity
exit cost
debt obligations
runway after exit
income recovery requirement
emergency reserve
```

例如：

```
Exit at 8 months liquidity
vs
Exit at 2 months liquidity
```

恢复能力完全不同。

---

# 22. `methodConsumer`

AST / BAZI / ZIWEI / NUM / HD / ECR / Tarot / I Ching：

只能提出：

```
what condition may deserve monitoring
```

不得建立：

```
exit trigger
recovery probability
future rescue claim
```

---

# 23. `currentRealityConsumer`

Current Reality 应至少提供：

```
whatHasChanged
whichTriggerIsApproaching
whatResourcesRemain
whatExitRoutesRemainOpen
whatRecoveryResourcesRemain
```

---

# 24. `runtimeConsumer`

NAV-25 可被：

```
My Reality Navigation
Career Navigation
Financial Navigation
Relationship Navigation
Estate Navigation
Structural Transition Planning
Professional Handoff
Scenario Runtime
Action Runtime
```

消费。

---

# 25. `academyConsumer`

Academy 可投影为：

> **Do not enter a high-impact path without knowing what would make you stop and what reality would still remain after you stop.**

中文：

> **不要进入一条高影响路径，却完全不知道什么情况会让你停止，也不知道停止以后还剩下什么现实可以恢复。**

---

# 26. `revisionTriggers`

以下情况必须重开 NAV-25：

```
exitCostChanged
contractChanged
minimumStateChanged
liquidityChanged
recoveryResourceChanged
newProfessionalInput
newLegalConstraint
newSupportAppeared
optionScaleChanged
downsideScenarioChanged
triggerReached
```

---

# 27. Canonical Exit / Recovery Model

```
{
  "exitRecoveryAssessmentId": "",
  "optionId": "",
  "exitTriggers": [],
  "exitRoutes": [
    {
      "routeId": "",
      "conditions": [],
      "costs": [],
      "timeRequired": "",
      "authorityRequirements": [],
      "status": ""
    }
  ],
  "recoveryRoutes": [
    {
      "routeId": "",
      "targetState": "",
      "requiredResources": [],
      "requiredTime": "",
      "dependencies": [],
      "unknowns": []
    }
  ],
  "recoveryMinimum": [],
  "lateExitRisks": [],
  "sources": [],
  "status": ""
}
```

---

# 28. Exit Trigger Rule

Exit trigger 必须回答：

```
WHAT CHANGED?
WHY DOES IT MATTER?
WHICH CONDITION IS NOW VIOLATED?
```

不能只写：

```
if things feel bad
```

---

# 29. Trigger Classes

建议至少支持：

```
DATE_TRIGGER
STATE_TRIGGER
THRESHOLD_TRIGGER
EVENT_TRIGGER
AUTHORITY_TRIGGER
MINIMUM_STATE_TRIGGER
```

例如：

```
DATE_TRIGGER:
review after 6 months

STATE_TRIGGER:
no viable clients

THRESHOLD_TRIGGER:
liquidity falls below confirmed floor

EVENT_TRIGGER:
key contract terminates

AUTHORITY_TRIGGER:
professional review requires pause
```

---

# 30. Early Exit Rule

有时较早退出虽然：

```
realizes loss sooner
```

却保留更多：

```
recovery capacity
optionality
liquidity
time
```

Navigation 应让这种结构可见。

---

# 31. Late Exit Rule

如果继续等待会使：

```
recovery resource shrink
```

应标记：

```
LATE_EXIT_RISK
```

这直接连接 NAV-18 Waiting Cost。

---

# 32. Exit Cost Rule

每个 exit route 必须尽量包括：

```
financial cost
time cost
legal cost
relationship cost
operational cost
residual effect
```

不能只说：

```
you can always leave
```

---

# 33. Recovery Target Rule

恢复目标不必是：

```
original state
```

可以是：

```
MINIMUM_ACCEPTABLE_RECOVERED_STATE
```

例如：

```
stable housing
basic income
6 months liquidity
employment re-entry
family care continuity
```

---

# 34. Recovery Time Rule

恢复不仅需要资源，也需要时间。

例如：

```
job re-entry
```

可能需要：

```
3–6 months
```

如果这个范围有现实依据，应纳入。

若无依据：

```
RECOVERY_TIME_UNKNOWN
```

---

# 35. Recovery Dependency Rule

恢复可能依赖：

```
market conditions
professional licence
support network
partner cooperation
available employer
cash buffer
```

这些依赖不能隐藏。

---

# 36. Recovery Capacity Rule

执行方案前应尽量检查：

```
post-failure capacity
```

而不是只检查：

```
entry capacity
```

一个方案如果需要耗尽全部资源才能进入，可能根本没有 recovery capacity。

---

# 37. Recovery Preservation Rule

为了保留恢复能力，有时应该在成功阶段也持续保留：

```
emergency reserve
professional network
credentials
insurance
backup supplier
secondary income source
```

但是否需要这些，应与具体方案相关。

---

# 38. No Infinite Rescue Rule

不能为了让方案看起来可恢复而无限添加假设：

```
family can lend
bank can lend
old employer will rehire
market will improve
```

如果没有支持，应保留：

```
RECOVERY_DEPENDENCY_UNCONFIRMED
```

---

# 39. Recovery vs Sunk Cost Rule

一旦 exit trigger 达到，过去投入不能自动成为继续理由。

冻结：

> **The resources already spent do not revoke an exit route that was established precisely to prevent deeper loss.**

中文：

> **已经投入的资源，不能在退出条件真正触发以后，反过来取消原本就是为了防止更大损失而建立的退出路线。**

---

# 40. Exit Trigger Drift Rule

用户可能在现实中不断把 trigger 往后移。

例如：

```
original:
exit at 6 months no traction

later:
wait 3 more months

later:
one more quarter
```

系统应标记：

```
EXIT_TRIGGER_DRIFT
```

但不能道德化。

需要问：

> 新证据是否真的使原 trigger 失效？

---

# 41. Partial Exit Rule

退出不一定是：

```
ALL OR NOTHING
```

可能包括：

```
reduce exposure
reduce hours
sell part
pause
stop one product
leave one market
end one commitment
```

这使 Exit Route 与 NAV-10 Response Level、NAV-17 Structural Alternative 连接。

---

# 42. Recovery Route Hierarchy

可以区分：

```
R1_STABILIZE
R2_RESTORE_MINIMUM
R3_REBUILD_CAPACITY
R4_REOPEN_OPTION_SPACE
```

例如：

```
Stabilize:
stop cash burn

Restore minimum:
secure essential income

Rebuild:
rebuild 6-month buffer

Reopen:
consider new career direction again
```

---

# 43. Other-People Rule

如果 Exit / Recovery 会影响：

```
partner
children
dependants
employees
co-owner
```

必须读取 NAV-08。

用户不能单方面把：

```
others absorb recovery cost
```

当成默认 recovery plan。

---

# 44. Professional Boundary Rule

在：

```
medical
legal
regulated financial
estate
```

领域，Exit / Recovery Route 可能需要专业 authority。

Navigation 只能组织，不得冒充专业程序。

---

# 45. Scenario-to-Trigger Rule

NAV-24 的 Downside 不自动等于 Exit Trigger。

正确关系：

```
Downside Scenario
↓
Observe actual condition
↓
Trigger threshold reached?
↓
Exit / Recovery action
```

Scenario 仍然只是条件路径。

---

# 46. Customer Projection Example

内部：

```
Option:
Independent consulting

Exit Trigger:
usable liquidity reaches 8 months
AND
qualified client pipeline remains below confirmed minimum

Exit Route:
stop expansion spend
return to active employment search
maintain current clients during transition

Recovery Minimum:
household essentials covered
health coverage maintained
6 months liquidity preserved

Recovery Route:
employment re-entry
+
retain consulting as secondary income
```

客户可以看到：

> **真正让这条路更可承担的，不是保证它一定成功，而是你已经知道如果它没有按预期发展，什么时候停止继续下注，以及停止以后怎样回来。**
> 
> 目前可以把一个关键复核点放在现金缓冲与客户进展之间：如果可用流动性下降到已经确认的边界，而稳定客户仍没有形成，就不再继续扩大投入，而是停止新增扩张成本，重新启动正式求职，同时保留已经能够产生收入的客户。这样做并不能消除失败的可能，却可以避免为了证明自己“再坚持一下”而把恢复所需的资源也一起耗尽。

---

# 47. Customer Actions

允许：

```
Confirm exit trigger
Change trigger
Add exit route
Add recovery route
Set recovery minimum
Add professional review
Reduce option scale
Mark dependency unknown
Continue
```

---

# 48. `status`

建议：

```
UNFORMED
PARTIAL
EXIT_ROUTE_READY
EXIT_ROUTE_WITH_COST
EXIT_ROUTE_UNKNOWN
RECOVERY_ROUTE_READY
RECOVERY_ROUTE_PARTIAL
RECOVERY_CAPACITY_INSUFFICIENT
TRIGGER_PENDING_CONFIRMATION
READY_FOR_DECISION_SUFFICIENCY
REOPENED
```

---

# 49. Fail-Closed Conditions

以下情况不得进入 NAV-26：

```
criticalExitTriggerUnknown
exitRouteInvented
recoveryCapacityFabricated
minimumStateNotConnected
contractOrLegalExitAssumed
thirdPartySupportAssumedWithoutConsent
symbolicReadingUsedAsExitAuthority
scenarioTreatedAsActualTrigger
recoveryDependencyHidden
decisionObjectChanged
```

---

# 50. Canonical Runtime Rule

> **Navigation must define how a high-impact option can be exited and how a minimum acceptable state can be recovered before treating the option as ready for final sufficiency review.**

中文：

> **Navigation 在把一个高影响选项送入最终充分性判断以前，必须先明确它怎样退出，以及最低可接受状态怎样恢复。**

---

# 51. Canonical Exit Rule

> **An exit route is not a prediction of failure; it is a boundary against allowing failure to consume the resources needed for recovery.**

中文：

> **退出路线不是对失败的预测，而是一条边界，用来防止失败继续吞噬本来应该留给恢复的资源。**

---

# 52. Canonical Recovery Rule

> **Recovery does not require restoring the past; it requires returning to a state from which meaningful choice becomes possible again.**

中文：

> **恢复并不要求回到过去原样，而是回到一个重新拥有真实选择能力的状态。**

---

# 53. Canonical Trigger Rule

> **An exit trigger must be tied to observable conditions, confirmed thresholds, or legitimate authority—not fear, symbolic interpretation, or retrospective regret alone.**

中文：

> **退出触发条件必须建立在可观察现实、已经确认的门槛或合法权威上，而不能只建立在恐惧、象征解释或事后后悔上。**

---

# 54. Canonical Preservation Rule

> **A strong exit design preserves enough capacity, value, and option space that a failed path does not become an unrecoverable life structure.**

中文：

> **好的退出设计，是在一条路径失败时仍然保留足够的容量、价值与选择空间，使一次失败不会被放大成无法恢复的生活结构。**

---

# 55. Final Canonical Form

```
NAV-25
EXIT / RECOVERY ROUTE
```

**Input**

```
Candidate Option
+
Baseline / Upside / Downside
+
Minimum Acceptable State
+
Reversibility
+
Available Recovery Capacity
```

**Process**

```
Determine:
When Would We Stop?
How Can We Exit?
What Will Exit Cost?
What Must Still Remain?
How Do We Recover?
What Reopens Choice?
```

**Output**

```
Exit Trigger Set
+
Exit Route
+
Recovery Route
+
Recovery Readiness State
```

**Boundary**

```
Exit is not failure prediction.
Recovery is not restoration.
A route is only real if its conditions actually exist.
```

modules.canonicalQuestion:
当我们永远不可能知道一切时，
什么时候已经知道得足够多，
可以不再把“还不确定”当成无限等待的理由？
modules.definition:
**Decision Sufficiency** 是 Navigation 对“当前已经掌握的现实、证据、未知、责任、可逆性、情景与恢复条件，是否已经足够支持下一步被负责任地承担”进行正式判断的机制。

它不是：

```
CERTAINTY
```

也不是：

```
COMPLETE INFORMATION
```

更不是：

```
CONFIDENCE FEELING
```

它真正回答的是：

> **在我们仍然不知道一切的情况下，当前已知是否已经足够，让这个决定进入下一步而不需要假装未知已经消失？**

因此必须冻结：

> **决策充分，不等于完全确定。它意味着已经知道得足够多，可以负责任地承担下一步。**

例如，一个人准备离开现职。

Navigation 并不需要知道：

```
未来收入一定是多少
下一份工作一定什么时候出现
市场一定怎样发展
```

这些事情可能永远无法完全知道。

但它应该至少知道：

```
为什么考虑改变
当前位置是什么
什么条件已经关闭 / 仍开放
等待和行动各自会发生什么
当前最低可接受状态
主要下行情景
退出条件
恢复路径
谁拥有决定权
哪些未知仍然存在
```

如果这些已经足够清楚，那么：

```
UNKNOWN REMAINS
```

并不自动意味着：

```
DECISION MUST WAIT
```

---
modules.navigationMeaning:
现实决定之所以困难，往往不是因为：

```
nothing is known
```

而是因为：

```
not everything is known
```

如果 Navigation 把：

```
complete knowledge
```

设为行动前提，那么重大人生决定几乎永远无法开始。

但如果系统反过来，只要“感觉差不多”就允许行动，又会失去责任边界。

因此 NAV-26 建立的是第三种状态：

```
NOT CERTAIN
+
SUFFICIENTLY GROUNDED
=
DECISION MAY PROCEED
```

它的核心结构是：

```
Known Reality
+
Relevant Evidence
+
Material Unknowns
+
Minimum State
+
Reversibility
+
Scenario Robustness
+
Exit / Recovery
+
Authority / Consent
↓
Is This Enough to Bear the Next Step?
```

---
modules.requiredInputs:
NAV-26 最低需要：

```
confirmedDecisionObject
currentPosition
remainingChoiceSpace
timeAssessment
inactionAssessment
reversibilityProfile
timeHorizonMap
authorityMap
changeThresholdState
responseLevel
continuationQualification
maintenanceCostState
capacityQualification
marginalReturnState
structuralAlternativeState
waitingQualification
preservationRequirements
goalValueAlignment
nonExchangeableConditions
minimumAcceptableState
scenarioSpace
baselineUpsideDownsideSet
exitRecoveryState
```

这意味着 NAV-26 是前 25 个模块第一次真正的：

```
CONVERGENCE POINT
```

它不重新产生这些判断。

它负责问：

> **这些判断放在一起以后，是否已经足够支持下一步？**

---
modules.optionalInputs:
```
financialNavigationProjection
profileNavigationProjection
currentRealityProjection
professionalInput
relationshipContext
legalOrContractualContext
sharedDecisionContext
externalCurrentEvidence
priorNavigationState
recentOutcomeHistory
```

这些只有在与 Decision Object 相关时进入。

---
modules.inputAuthorityClasses:
NAV-26 必须保留前面所有 authority distinctions。

至少包括：

```
CURRENT_FACT
USER_REPORTED_CURRENT
VERIFIED_RECORD
PROFESSIONAL_INPUT
SUPPORTED_INFERENCE
SCENARIO_ASSUMPTION
INTERPRETIVE_CONTEXT
UNKNOWN
```

Decision Sufficiency 不能通过：

```
more interpretive material
```

来假装补齐：

```
missing material reality
```

例如：

```
financial runway unknown
```

不能靠：

```
BaZi + Tarot + Zi Wei agreement
```

变成：

```
sufficient financial basis
```

---
modules.allowedInference:
NAV-26 可以：

## A. 判断仍有未知，但未知不再改变当前下一步

例如：

```
exact future salary unknown
```

但如果当前动作只是：

```
apply for three roles
```

那么这个未知可能不阻止行动。

可以标记：

```
UNKNOWN_NOT_ACTION_BLOCKING
```

---

## B. 判断某个未知仍然会改变整个决定

例如：

```
contract may contain RM200k termination liability
```

在尚未确认前可能属于：

```
CRITICAL_UNKNOWN
```

阻止重大执行。

---

## C. 判断当前信息只够做小动作

例如：

```
full relocation decision not sufficient
```

但：

```
visit location
speak to school
verify visa
```

已经足够。

可以输出：

```
SUFFICIENT_FOR_REVERSIBLE_ACTION
```

---

## D. 判断继续等待已经不会显著提高充分性

如果：

```
remaining unknowns
cannot reasonably be resolved before action
```

而：

```
minimum state protected
exit route ready
action reversible enough
```

则可以判断：

```
FURTHER_INFORMATION_HAS_LOW_DECISION_VALUE
```

---

## E. 判断“资料很多”仍然不足

例如：

```
10 reports
5 readings
long analysis
```

但：

```
cash flow unknown
decision owner unclear
partner consent missing
```

则仍然：

```
INSUFFICIENT
```

---
modules.forbiddenInference:
NAV-26 严禁：

## A. 把确定感当充分性

```
“I feel sure”
≠
DECISION_SUFFICIENT
```

---

## B. 把资料量当充分性

```
MORE DATA
≠
MORE SUFFICIENCY
```

---

## C. 把多方法一致当充分性

禁止：

```
BaZi + Zi Wei + Tarot + Astrology agree
→ decision sufficient
```

---

## D. 把专业意见当整个人生决定的充分性

专业人士只能提供其领域内的 authority。

---

## E. 因为时间紧就自动降低标准

```
urgent
≠
sufficient
```

---

## F. 因为不可能知道全部就放弃任何门槛

```
uncertainty unavoidable
≠
anything goes
```

---
modules.decisionEffect:
NAV-26 主要影响：

```
ACTION_ADMISSION
ACTION_SCALE
WAIT_ACT_BALANCE
ESCALATION_REQUIREMENT
INFORMATION_GATHERING_PRIORITY
FINAL_DECISION_READINESS
```

核心 effect：

```
DECISION_READINESS
```

---
modules.decisionThresholdEffect:
NAV-26 不建立最终统一 threshold 公式。

完整 threshold mechanics 由：

```
NAV-27
Impact / Reversibility Threshold
```

进一步处理。

NAV-26 负责回答：

> **目前的信息与现实理解，是否已经达到“可以进入某种等级行动”的充分状态？**

而 NAV-27 负责：

> **这类行动究竟需要多高程度的充分性？**

两者必须分开。

---
modules.authorityBoundary:
NAV-26 可以：

- 判断信息是否足够；
- 判断未知是否阻断；
- 判断下一步允许到什么规模；
- 判断是否需要继续补资料；
- 判断是否应进入专业 / shared review；
- 判断是否已经可以行动。

NAV-26 不可以：

- 宣称未来确定；
- 替用户作最终选择；
- 用解释性证据填补现实关键未知；
- 自动批准受监管行动；
- 自动越过 consent；
- 将“充分”解释成“正确”。

---
modules.humanDecisionBoundary:
Decision Sufficiency 与 Decision Choice 必须严格分开。

系统可以判断：

```
Option A is decision-sufficient for bounded action.
```

但不能因此输出：

```
Therefore choose A.
```

用户仍然可以：

```
choose A
choose B
wait
reject both
seek more information
```

只要不违反合法 authority / hard constraint。

因此冻结：

> **Sufficiency determines whether a decision can responsibly proceed; it does not determine which decision a person must choose.**

中文：

> **充分性决定的是一个决定是否已经可以负责任地向前推进，而不是一个人必须选择哪一个决定。**

---

modules.relatedBookFoundations:
## Book VII｜Reality Observation

Book VII 拥有：

```
Evidence Sufficiency
Observation Boundary
Uncertainty
Knowledge State
```

NAV-26 必须严格区分：

```
EVIDENCE SUFFICIENCY
≠
DECISION SUFFICIENCY
```

一个 claim 可以：

```
evidence insufficient
```

但某个低风险 reversible action 仍然可能：

```
decision sufficient
```

反过来：

某个事实可能证据充分，但整个决定仍然不充分。

---

提供：

```
capacity
recovery
continuity condition
```

作为是否可承担下一步的重要现实基础。

modules.profileConsumer:
Profile 可帮助理解：

```
uncertainty tolerance
decision style
over-analysis tendency
impulsivity tendency
```

但这些只能作为：

```
DECISION_BEHAVIOR_CONTEXT
```

不能决定：

```
SUFFICIENT
```

---
modules.financialConsumer:
Financial 对重大 Decision Sufficiency 非常重要。

尤其：

```
usable liquidity
debt obligations
fixed commitments
dependants
runway
downside affordability
```

如果 Financial 是当前决定的关键现实面，而资料缺失，则：

```
critical financial unknown
```

可能直接阻断高影响行动。

---
modules.methodConsumer:
AST / BAZI / ZIWEI / NUM / HD / ECR / Tarot / I Ching：

可以：

```
add interpretive context
surface a question
highlight a possible tension
```

但不得：

```
close critical unknown
create factual sufficiency
raise decision authority
```

---
modules.currentRealityConsumer:
Current Reality 是 NAV-26 的主要 factual anchor。

至少应提供：

```
whatIsKnownNow
whatChanged
whatIsVerified
whatIsReported
whatRemainsUnknown
whatWouldActuallyChangeDecision
```

---
modules.runtimeConsumer:
NAV-26 可被：

```
My Reality Navigation
Career Navigation
Financial Navigation
Relationship Navigation
Estate Navigation
Structural Transition Planning
Professional Handoff
Scenario Runtime
Action Runtime
```

消费。

这是第一个应该明确输出：

```
CAN PROCEED?
AT WHAT SCALE?
WHAT STILL BLOCKS?
```

的核心 module。

---
modules.academyConsumer:
Academy 可投影为：

> **Decision sufficiency is not knowing everything. It is knowing enough to responsibly bear the next step.**

中文：

> **决策充分不是知道一切，而是已经知道得足够多，可以负责任地承担下一步。**

```
maintenanceCostState
capacityQualification
marginalReturnState
structuralAlternativeState
waitingQualification
preservationRequirements
goalValueAlignment
nonExchangeableConditions
minimumAcceptableState
scenarioSpace
baselineUpsideDownsideSet
exitRecoveryState
```

这意味着 NAV-26 是前 25 个模块第一次真正的：

```
CONVERGENCE POINT
```

它不重新产生这些判断。

它负责问：

> **这些判断放在一起以后，是否已经足够支持下一步？**

---

canonicalSections.heading: `optionalInputs`
canonicalSections.body:
```
financialNavigationProjection
profileNavigationProjection
currentRealityProjection
professionalInput
relationshipContext
legalOrContractualContext
sharedDecisionContext
externalCurrentEvidence
priorNavigationState
recentOutcomeHistory
```

这些只有在与 Decision Object 相关时进入。

---

canonicalSections.heading: `inputAuthorityClasses`
canonicalSections.body:
NAV-26 必须保留前面所有 authority distinctions。

至少包括：

```
CURRENT_FACT
USER_REPORTED_CURRENT
VERIFIED_RECORD
PROFESSIONAL_INPUT
SUPPORTED_INFERENCE
SCENARIO_ASSUMPTION
INTERPRETIVE_CONTEXT
UNKNOWN
```

Decision Sufficiency 不能通过：

```
more interpretive material
```

来假装补齐：

```
missing material reality
```

例如：

```
financial runway unknown
```

不能靠：

```
BaZi + Tarot + Zi Wei agreement
```

变成：

```
sufficient financial basis
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Core Sufficiency States
canonicalSections.body:
建议至少区分：

```
INSUFFICIENT
PARTIALLY_SUFFICIENT
SUFFICIENT_FOR_INFORMATION_GATHERING
SUFFICIENT_FOR_REVERSIBLE_ACTION
SUFFICIENT_FOR_BOUNDED_ACTION
SUFFICIENT_FOR_HIGH_IMPACT_REVIEW
DECISION_SUFFICIENT
SUFFICIENCY_BLOCKED_BY_AUTHORITY
SUFFICIENCY_BLOCKED_BY_CRITICAL_UNKNOWN
```

---

## A. `INSUFFICIENT`

关键问题仍然不清楚。

例如：

```
Decision Object unclear
Current Position stale
Critical minimum unknown
Exit route absent
```

不应继续进入重大行动。

---

## B. `PARTIALLY_SUFFICIENT`

可以继续分析，但不足以行动。

---

## C. `SUFFICIENT_FOR_INFORMATION_GATHERING`

已经足够知道：

```
what we still need to learn
```

但不是足够决定。

例如：

```
need contract clarification
need professional review
need partner consent
```

---

## D. `SUFFICIENT_FOR_REVERSIBLE_ACTION`

信息仍不完整，但当前行动：

```
small
bounded
reversible
low impact
```

可以通过现实反馈继续学习。

---

## E. `SUFFICIENT_FOR_BOUNDED_ACTION`

可以执行一个明确范围、明确时间、明确退出条件的行动。

---

## F. `SUFFICIENT_FOR_HIGH_IMPACT_REVIEW`

重大行动已经接近充分，但还需要：

```
professional
shared-decision
consent
formal review
```

中的一个或多个完成。

---

## G. `DECISION_SUFFICIENT`

当前已知、未知与边界已经足够清楚，可以负责任地承担下一步。

注意：

```
DECISION_SUFFICIENT
≠
OUTCOME GUARANTEED
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: What Sufficiency Is Made Of
canonicalSections.body:
Decision Sufficiency 不应该压成一个神秘分数。

建议至少由以下维度共同构成：

```
OBJECT_CLARITY
POSITION_SUFFICIENCY
OPTION_SPACE_SUFFICIENCY
TIME_SUFFICIENCY
REVERSIBILITY_SUFFICIENCY
AUTHORITY_SUFFICIENCY
VALUE_SUFFICIENCY
MINIMUM_STATE_SUFFICIENCY
SCENARIO_SUFFICIENCY
RECOVERY_SUFFICIENCY
CRITICAL_UNKNOWN_STATE
```

但这些不应被简单平均。

---

canonicalSections.heading: `allowedInference`
canonicalSections.body:
NAV-26 可以：

## A. 判断仍有未知，但未知不再改变当前下一步

例如：

```
exact future salary unknown
```

但如果当前动作只是：

```
apply for three roles
```

那么这个未知可能不阻止行动。

可以标记：

```
UNKNOWN_NOT_ACTION_BLOCKING
```

---

## B. 判断某个未知仍然会改变整个决定

例如：

```
contract may contain RM200k termination liability
```

在尚未确认前可能属于：

```
CRITICAL_UNKNOWN
```

阻止重大执行。

---

## C. 判断当前信息只够做小动作

例如：

```
full relocation decision not sufficient
```

但：

```
visit location
speak to school
verify visa
```

已经足够。

可以输出：

```
SUFFICIENT_FOR_REVERSIBLE_ACTION
```

---

## D. 判断继续等待已经不会显著提高充分性

如果：

```
remaining unknowns
cannot reasonably be resolved before action
```

而：

```
minimum state protected
exit route ready
action reversible enough
```

则可以判断：

```
FURTHER_INFORMATION_HAS_LOW_DECISION_VALUE
```

---

## E. 判断“资料很多”仍然不足

例如：

```
10 reports
5 readings
long analysis
```

但：

```
cash flow unknown
decision owner unclear
partner consent missing
```

则仍然：

```
INSUFFICIENT
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: `forbiddenInference`
canonicalSections.body:
NAV-26 严禁：

## A. 把确定感当充分性

```
“I feel sure”
≠
DECISION_SUFFICIENT
```

---

## B. 把资料量当充分性

```
MORE DATA
≠
MORE SUFFICIENCY
```

---

## C. 把多方法一致当充分性

禁止：

```
BaZi + Zi Wei + Tarot + Astrology agree
→ decision sufficient
```

---

## D. 把专业意见当整个人生决定的充分性

专业人士只能提供其领域内的 authority。

---

## E. 因为时间紧就自动降低标准

```
urgent
≠
sufficient
```

---

## F. 因为不可能知道全部就放弃任何门槛

```
uncertainty unavoidable
≠
anything goes
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: `decisionEffect`
canonicalSections.body:
NAV-26 主要影响：

```
ACTION_ADMISSION
ACTION_SCALE
WAIT_ACT_BALANCE
ESCALATION_REQUIREMENT
INFORMATION_GATHERING_PRIORITY
FINAL_DECISION_READINESS
```

核心 effect：

```
DECISION_READINESS
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: `decisionThresholdEffect`
canonicalSections.body:
NAV-26 不建立最终统一 threshold 公式。

完整 threshold mechanics 由：

```
NAV-27
Impact / Reversibility Threshold
```

进一步处理。

NAV-26 负责回答：

> **目前的信息与现实理解，是否已经达到“可以进入某种等级行动”的充分状态？**

而 NAV-27 负责：

> **这类行动究竟需要多高程度的充分性？**

两者必须分开。

---

canonicalSections.heading: `authorityBoundary`
canonicalSections.body:
NAV-26 可以：

- 判断信息是否足够；
- 判断未知是否阻断；
- 判断下一步允许到什么规模；
- 判断是否需要继续补资料；
- 判断是否应进入专业 / shared review；
- 判断是否已经可以行动。

NAV-26 不可以：

- 宣称未来确定；
- 替用户作最终选择；
- 用解释性证据填补现实关键未知；
- 自动批准受监管行动；
- 自动越过 consent；
- 将“充分”解释成“正确”。

---

canonicalSections.heading: `humanDecisionBoundary`
canonicalSections.body:
Decision Sufficiency 与 Decision Choice 必须严格分开。

系统可以判断：

```
Option A is decision-sufficient for bounded action.
```

但不能因此输出：

```
Therefore choose A.
```

用户仍然可以：

```
choose A
choose B
wait
reject both
seek more information
```

只要不违反合法 authority / hard constraint。

因此冻结：

> **Sufficiency determines whether a decision can responsibly proceed; it does not determine which decision a person must choose.**

中文：

> **充分性决定的是一个决定是否已经可以负责任地向前推进，而不是一个人必须选择哪一个决定。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: `sourceSections`
canonicalSections.body:
主要来源：

```
Book VIII
15.41–15.50｜Deciding Under Unknown
```

尤其：

```
15.41｜我们永远不会知道全部
15.42｜未知不等于不能决定
15.43｜什么时候还需要更多资料
15.44｜什么时候更多资料已经不会改变决定
15.45｜可逆性会改变所需确定程度
15.46｜影响越大，所需充分程度越高
15.47｜影响别人，会改变你的决定权
15.48｜证据充分与决策充分不是同一件事
15.49｜什么时候必须把决定升级给别人
15.50｜已经知道得足够多，是什么意思
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: `relatedBookFoundations`
canonicalSections.body:
## Book VII｜Reality Observation

Book VII 拥有：

```
Evidence Sufficiency
Observation Boundary
Uncertainty
Knowledge State
```

NAV-26 必须严格区分：

```
EVIDENCE SUFFICIENCY
≠
DECISION SUFFICIENCY
```

一个 claim 可以：

```
evidence insufficient
```

但某个低风险 reversible action 仍然可能：

```
decision sufficient
```

反过来：

某个事实可能证据充分，但整个决定仍然不充分。

---

## Book III｜Reality Continuity

提供：

```
capacity
recovery
continuity condition
```

作为是否可承担下一步的重要现实基础。

---

canonicalSections.heading: `profileConsumer`
canonicalSections.body:
Profile 可帮助理解：

```
uncertainty tolerance
decision style
over-analysis tendency
impulsivity tendency
```

但这些只能作为：

```
DECISION_BEHAVIOR_CONTEXT
```

不能决定：

```
SUFFICIENT
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: `financialConsumer`
canonicalSections.body:
Financial 对重大 Decision Sufficiency 非常重要。

尤其：

```
usable liquidity
debt obligations
fixed commitments
dependants
runway
downside affordability
```

如果 Financial 是当前决定的关键现实面，而资料缺失，则：

```
critical financial unknown
```

可能直接阻断高影响行动。

---

canonicalSections.heading: `methodConsumer`
canonicalSections.body:
AST / BAZI / ZIWEI / NUM / HD / ECR / Tarot / I Ching：

可以：

```
add interpretive context
surface a question
highlight a possible tension
```

但不得：

```
close critical unknown
create factual sufficiency
raise decision authority
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: `currentRealityConsumer`
canonicalSections.body:
Current Reality 是 NAV-26 的主要 factual anchor。

至少应提供：

```
whatIsKnownNow
whatChanged
whatIsVerified
whatIsReported
whatRemainsUnknown
whatWouldActuallyChangeDecision
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: `runtimeConsumer`
canonicalSections.body:
NAV-26 可被：

```
My Reality Navigation
Career Navigation
Financial Navigation
Relationship Navigation
Estate Navigation
Structural Transition Planning
Professional Handoff
Scenario Runtime
Action Runtime
```

消费。

这是第一个应该明确输出：

```
CAN PROCEED?
AT WHAT SCALE?
WHAT STILL BLOCKS?
```

的核心 module。

---

canonicalSections.heading: `academyConsumer`
canonicalSections.body:
Academy 可投影为：

> **Decision sufficiency is not knowing everything. It is knowing enough to responsibly bear the next step.**

中文：

> **决策充分不是知道一切，而是已经知道得足够多，可以负责任地承担下一步。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: `revisionTriggers`
canonicalSections.body:
以下情况必须重开 NAV-26：

```
decisionObjectChanged
currentPositionChanged
criticalUnknownResolved
newCriticalUnknownAppeared
minimumStateChanged
reversibilityChanged
scenarioChanged
exitRouteChanged
recoveryCapacityChanged
authorityChanged
consentChanged
professionalInputArrived
optionScaleChanged
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Canonical Decision Sufficiency Model
canonicalSections.body:
建议：

```
{
  "decisionSufficiencyId": "",
  "decisionObjectId": "",
  "optionId": "",
  "state": "INSUFFICIENT | PARTIALLY_SUFFICIENT | SUFFICIENT_FOR_INFORMATION_GATHERING | SUFFICIENT_FOR_REVERSIBLE_ACTION | SUFFICIENT_FOR_BOUNDED_ACTION | SUFFICIENT_FOR_HIGH_IMPACT_REVIEW | DECISION_SUFFICIENT | SUFFICIENCY_BLOCKED_BY_AUTHORITY | SUFFICIENCY_BLOCKED_BY_CRITICAL_UNKNOWN",
  "knowns": [],
  "materialUnknowns": [],
  "criticalUnknowns": [],
  "nonBlockingUnknowns": [],
  "minimumStateStatus": "",
  "reversibilityStatus": "",
  "scenarioStatus": "",
  "exitRecoveryStatus": "",
  "authorityStatus": "",
  "permittedActionScale": "",
  "remainingRequirements": [],
  "sources": [],
  "status": ""
}
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Evidence Sufficiency vs Decision Sufficiency Rule
canonicalSections.body:
冻结：

```
EVIDENCE SUFFICIENCY
≠
DECISION SUFFICIENCY
```

正式规则：

> **Evidence sufficiency asks whether a claim is adequately supported. Decision sufficiency asks whether the decision-maker knows enough, despite remaining uncertainty, to responsibly bear the next step.**

中文：

> **证据充分问的是一个判断有没有得到足够支持；决策充分问的是，即使仍有未知，决定者是否已经知道得足够多，可以负责任地承担下一步。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: Unknown Classification Rule
canonicalSections.body:
所有 material unknown 应至少分类：

```
CRITICAL_UNKNOWN
ACTION_RELEVANT_UNKNOWN
NON_BLOCKING_UNKNOWN
UNRESOLVABLE_BEFORE_ACTION
```

---

## `CRITICAL_UNKNOWN`

如果未知答案不同，会改变：

```
option eligibility
hard minimum
authority
major cost
reversibility
```

则属于 critical。

---

## `ACTION_RELEVANT_UNKNOWN`

会改变 action scale 或 timing，但未必阻止所有行动。

---

## `NON_BLOCKING_UNKNOWN`

即使未知，当前下一步仍然合理。

---

## `UNRESOLVABLE_BEFORE_ACTION`

现实只能通过行动反馈知道。

这种未知特别适合与：

```
small reversible action
```

结合。

---

canonicalSections.heading: More Information Rule
canonicalSections.body:
继续搜集资料只有在：

```
new information
could materially change
decision / option / threshold / action scale
```

时才具有明显 Navigation 价值。

否则：

```
MORE INFORMATION
```

可能只是：

```
MORE DELAY
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Information Value Rule
canonicalSections.body:
建议引入：

```
INFORMATION_VALUE
```

状态：

```
HIGH
MATERIAL
LOW
EXHAUSTED
UNKNOWN
```

但不需要将其量化成统一分数。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Information Saturation Rule
canonicalSections.body:
如果：

```
new reports
new searches
new readings
new analysis
```

反复没有改变：

```
option space
minimum state
critical unknowns
action scale
```

可以标记：

```
INFORMATION_SATURATION
```

这不代表：

```
all knowledge complete
```

只代表：

```
additional information currently has low marginal decision value
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Analysis Paralysis Boundary
canonicalSections.body:
系统不能诊断：

```
analysis paralysis
```

但可以识别：

```
REPEATED_INFORMATION_GATHERING_WITHOUT_DECISION_RELEVANT_CHANGE
```

然后问：

> 新增资料现在究竟还准备改变哪个判断？

---

canonicalSections.heading: Action-as-Learning Rule
canonicalSections.body:
如果：

```
remaining unknown
cannot be resolved by more passive analysis
```

而存在：

```
bounded
reversible
low-impact
observable
```

行动，

Navigation 可以允许：

```
ACTION_FOR_INFORMATION
```

例如：

```
pilot
trial
conversation
application
short stay
small allocation
```

但仍须符合 domain safety。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Sufficiency Is Action-Scale Specific
canonicalSections.body:
冻结：

```
SUFFICIENT FOR X
```

而不是只有：

```
SUFFICIENT / NOT SUFFICIENT
```

例如：

```
sufficient to research
sufficient to apply
sufficient to test
not sufficient to resign
```

这是 NAV-26 最重要的 runtime 原则之一。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Small-Step Sufficiency Rule
canonicalSections.body:
如果重大行动不充分，不代表：

```
nothing can be done
```

Navigation 应检查：

```
what smaller action is already sufficient?
```

这与：

```
NAV-06 Reversibility
NAV-10 Response Level
```

直接连接。

---

canonicalSections.heading: High-Impact Sufficiency Rule
canonicalSections.body:
高影响方案必须特别检查：

```
hard minimum protected
authority clear
consent clear
critical unknowns bounded
downside tested
exit route ready
recovery capacity real
```

否则不能标记：

```
DECISION_SUFFICIENT
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Sufficiency and Urgency Rule
canonicalSections.body:
当 deadline 临近时，可能出现：

```
time insufficient
+
decision still insufficient
```

系统不得假装充分。

可以选择：

```
decline
pause
escalate
take smaller reversible step
accept explicit residual uncertainty
```

具体取决于现实。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Sufficiency and Inaction Rule
canonicalSections.body:
不行动也需要充分性。

例如：

```
stay in current role for another year
```

如果 NAV-18 已显示高 Waiting Cost，继续等待本身不能逃避 NAV-26。

因此：

```
INACTION SUFFICIENCY
```

也应存在。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Sufficiency and Status Quo Rule
canonicalSections.body:
当前路径不能因为：

```
already operating
```

就被默认视为：

```
decision sufficient forever
```

一旦 NAV-09 / NAV-13 重开，继续路径也要重新通过 NAV-26。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Sufficiency and Shared Decision Rule
canonicalSections.body:
如果：

```
SHARED_DECISION
```

则：

```
one person feels ready
```

不等于：

```
decision sufficient
```

必须满足 NAV-08 的 shared authority / consent。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Sufficiency and Professional Review Rule
canonicalSections.body:
如果：

```
PROFESSIONAL_REQUIRED
```

则即使其他条件全部充分：

```
professional requirement unresolved
```

仍应：

```
SUFFICIENCY_BLOCKED_BY_AUTHORITY
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Sufficiency and Scenario Rule
canonicalSections.body:
Scenario Space 的作用不是消灭未知。

它让系统知道：

```
what kinds of unknowns we can still carry
```

如果 Downside：

```
remains above minimum
```

未知可承担度提高。

如果 Downside：

```
breaches hard minimum
```

则需要更强 protection。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Sufficiency and Exit Rule
canonicalSections.body:
一个 option 如果：

```
uncertain
```

但：

```
strong exit
strong recovery
high reversibility
```

可能较早达到 bounded-action sufficiency。

相反：

```
uncertain
+
no exit
+
low reversibility
```

则需要更高门槛。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Sufficiency State Must Explain Why
canonicalSections.body:
系统不得只显示：

```
DECISION SUFFICIENT
```

必须至少给出：

```
what is known
what remains unknown
why the unknown is still bearable
what action scale is allowed
what would reopen the decision
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Customer Projection Example
canonicalSections.body:
内部：

```
Decision:
Leave current role for independent consulting

Known:
current workload unsustainable at preferred level
12 months usable liquidity
minimum household floor confirmed
client pilot validated
exit / recovery route ready

Unknown:
exact time to stable consulting income
future market demand

State:
SUFFICIENT_FOR_BOUNDED_ACTION

Allowed scale:
begin staged transition

Not yet sufficient:
immediate full irreversible expansion
```

客户可以看到：

> **现在已经不是“资料够不够多”的问题，而是剩下的未知会不会改变你下一步能够承担什么。**
> 
> 目前你已经知道当前工作结构的问题在哪里，也确认了家庭最低财务边界、可用现金缓冲、一个可以测试的客户来源，以及如果独立收入没有按预期形成时怎样停止扩张并恢复就业。真正仍然不知道的，是收入什么时候能够稳定，以及未来市场会怎样变化；这两项未知很重要，却不一定必须在行动以前完全消失。
> 
> 因此目前的信息已经足够支持一个有边界、可复核的转换步骤，却还不足以把所有现有收入结构一次性撤掉并进行不可逆扩张。这里的“充分”不是说未来已经确定，而是下一步已经有能力被承担。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Customer Actions
canonicalSections.body:
允许：

```
Proceed with bounded action
Gather one more critical input
Reduce action scale
Request professional review
Confirm remaining unknown
Accept residual uncertainty
Wait with reason
Reopen decision
Continue
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: `status`
canonicalSections.body:
建议：

```
UNFORMED
PARTIAL
INSUFFICIENT
INFORMATION_GATHERING_SUFFICIENT
REVERSIBLE_ACTION_SUFFICIENT
BOUNDED_ACTION_SUFFICIENT
HIGH_IMPACT_REVIEW_READY
DECISION_SUFFICIENT
BLOCKED_BY_CRITICAL_UNKNOWN
BLOCKED_BY_AUTHORITY
REOPENED
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Fail-Closed Conditions
canonicalSections.body:
以下情况不得进入 NAV-27：

```
decisionObjectNotConfirmed
criticalUnknownHidden
hardMinimumUnresolved
authorityUnclear
consentMissing
professionalRequirementIgnored
scenarioDownsideNotTested
exitRecoveryMissingForHighImpactAction
symbolicInterpretationUsedToCloseMaterialUnknown
currentPositionStale
decisionSufficiencyDeclaredFromConfidenceAlone
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Canonical Runtime Rule
canonicalSections.body:
> **Navigation must determine whether enough is known to responsibly bear the next step without pretending that all uncertainty has disappeared.**

中文：

> **Navigation 必须判断当前是否已经知道得足够多，可以负责任地承担下一步，同时不能假装所有未知都已经消失。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: Canonical Sufficiency Rule
canonicalSections.body:
> **Decision sufficiency means enough knowledge, reality grounding, authority clarity, downside awareness, and recovery capacity for the scale of action being considered.**

中文：

> **决策充分意味着：针对正在考虑的行动规模，已经拥有足够的现实依据、权威清晰度、下行情景理解与恢复能力。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: Canonical Uncertainty Rule
canonicalSections.body:
> **Remaining uncertainty does not block a decision unless it can materially change eligibility, responsibility, minimum-state protection, or the scale of action that can be safely borne.**

中文：

> **剩余未知只有在可能实质改变选项资格、责任边界、最低状态保护或可承担行动规模时，才应该阻断决定。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: Canonical Information Rule
canonicalSections.body:
> **More information is valuable only while it can still materially change the decision.**

中文：

> **只有当新增信息仍可能实质改变决定时，继续获取更多信息才继续具有明显价值。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: Canonical Action-Scale Rule
canonicalSections.body:
> **A decision may be sufficient for a small reversible step while remaining insufficient for a large irreversible commitment.**

中文：

> **一个决定可以已经充分到足以支持一个小而可逆的步骤，同时仍然不足以支持一个巨大且难以撤回的承诺。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: Canonical Human Authority Rule
canonicalSections.body:
> **Navigation can judge whether a decision is sufficiently grounded to proceed; it does not acquire the right to make the decision because sufficiency has been reached.**

中文：

> **Navigation 可以判断一个决定是否已经获得足够现实基础继续推进，却不会因为“已经充分”就取得替人作决定的权利。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: Final Canonical Form
canonicalSections.body:
```
NAV-26
DECISION SUFFICIENCY
```

**Input**

```
Current Reality
+
Evidence
+
Material Unknowns
+
Values / Minimums
+
Scenarios
+
Reversibility
+
Exit / Recovery
+
Authority
```

**Process**

```
Ask:
What do we know?
What remains unknown?
Which unknowns can still change the decision?
What scale of action can current knowledge support?
What would still require more evidence, consent, or authority?
```

**Output**

```
Decision Sufficiency State
+
Permitted Action Scale
+
Remaining Blocking Conditions
```

**Boundary**

```
Enough is not everything.
Unknown is not automatically a reason to wait.
Sufficient does not mean certain.
Sufficient does not mean the system chooses.
```

modules.canonicalText:
# NAV-26｜Decision Sufficiency

## 决策充分｜什么时候已经知道得足够多，可以负责任地承担下一步

**Canonical Question｜规范问题**

> **当我们永远不可能知道一切时，什么时候已经知道得足够多，可以不再把“还不确定”当成无限等待的理由？**

---

## 1. `moduleId`

```
NAV-26
```

## 2. `canonicalTitleZh`

```
决策充分
```

## 3. `canonicalTitleEn`

```
Decision Sufficiency
```

## 4. `canonicalQuestion`

```
当我们永远不可能知道一切时，
什么时候已经知道得足够多，
可以不再把“还不确定”当成无限等待的理由？
```

---

# 5. `definition`

**Decision Sufficiency** 是 Navigation 对“当前已经掌握的现实、证据、未知、责任、可逆性、情景与恢复条件，是否已经足够支持下一步被负责任地承担”进行正式判断的机制。

它不是：

```
CERTAINTY
```

也不是：

```
COMPLETE INFORMATION
```

更不是：

```
CONFIDENCE FEELING
```

它真正回答的是：

> **在我们仍然不知道一切的情况下，当前已知是否已经足够，让这个决定进入下一步而不需要假装未知已经消失？**

因此必须冻结：

> **决策充分，不等于完全确定。它意味着已经知道得足够多，可以负责任地承担下一步。**

例如，一个人准备离开现职。

Navigation 并不需要知道：

```
未来收入一定是多少
下一份工作一定什么时候出现
市场一定怎样发展
```

这些事情可能永远无法完全知道。

但它应该至少知道：

```
为什么考虑改变
当前位置是什么
什么条件已经关闭 / 仍开放
等待和行动各自会发生什么
当前最低可接受状态
主要下行情景
退出条件
恢复路径
谁拥有决定权
哪些未知仍然存在
```

如果这些已经足够清楚，那么：

```
UNKNOWN REMAINS
```

并不自动意味着：

```
DECISION MUST WAIT
```

---

# 6. `navigationMeaning`

现实决定之所以困难，往往不是因为：

```
nothing is known
```

而是因为：

```
not everything is known
```

如果 Navigation 把：

```
complete knowledge
```

设为行动前提，那么重大人生决定几乎永远无法开始。

但如果系统反过来，只要“感觉差不多”就允许行动，又会失去责任边界。

因此 NAV-26 建立的是第三种状态：

```
NOT CERTAIN
+
SUFFICIENTLY GROUNDED
=
DECISION MAY PROCEED
```

它的核心结构是：

```
Known Reality
+
Relevant Evidence
+
Material Unknowns
+
Minimum State
+
Reversibility
+
Scenario Robustness
+
Exit / Recovery
+
Authority / Consent
↓
Is This Enough to Bear the Next Step?
```

---

# 7. `requiredInputs`

NAV-26 最低需要：

```
confirmedDecisionObject
currentPosition
remainingChoiceSpace
timeAssessment
inactionAssessment
reversibilityProfile
timeHorizonMap
authorityMap
changeThresholdState
responseLevel
continuationQualification
maintenanceCostState
capacityQualification
marginalReturnState
structuralAlternativeState
waitingQualification
preservationRequirements
goalValueAlignment
nonExchangeableConditions
minimumAcceptableState
scenarioSpace
baselineUpsideDownsideSet
exitRecoveryState
```

这意味着 NAV-26 是前 25 个模块第一次真正的：

```
CONVERGENCE POINT
```

它不重新产生这些判断。

它负责问：

> **这些判断放在一起以后，是否已经足够支持下一步？**

---

# 8. `optionalInputs`

```
financialNavigationProjection
profileNavigationProjection
currentRealityProjection
professionalInput
relationshipContext
legalOrContractualContext
sharedDecisionContext
externalCurrentEvidence
priorNavigationState
recentOutcomeHistory
```

这些只有在与 Decision Object 相关时进入。

---

# 9. `inputAuthorityClasses`

NAV-26 必须保留前面所有 authority distinctions。

至少包括：

```
CURRENT_FACT
USER_REPORTED_CURRENT
VERIFIED_RECORD
PROFESSIONAL_INPUT
SUPPORTED_INFERENCE
SCENARIO_ASSUMPTION
INTERPRETIVE_CONTEXT
UNKNOWN
```

Decision Sufficiency 不能通过：

```
more interpretive material
```

来假装补齐：

```
missing material reality
```

例如：

```
financial runway unknown
```

不能靠：

```
BaZi + Tarot + Zi Wei agreement
```

变成：

```
sufficient financial basis
```

---

# 10. Core Sufficiency States

建议至少区分：

```
INSUFFICIENT
PARTIALLY_SUFFICIENT
SUFFICIENT_FOR_INFORMATION_GATHERING
SUFFICIENT_FOR_REVERSIBLE_ACTION
SUFFICIENT_FOR_BOUNDED_ACTION
SUFFICIENT_FOR_HIGH_IMPACT_REVIEW
DECISION_SUFFICIENT
SUFFICIENCY_BLOCKED_BY_AUTHORITY
SUFFICIENCY_BLOCKED_BY_CRITICAL_UNKNOWN
```

---

## A. `INSUFFICIENT`

关键问题仍然不清楚。

例如：

```
Decision Object unclear
Current Position stale
Critical minimum unknown
Exit route absent
```

不应继续进入重大行动。

---

## B. `PARTIALLY_SUFFICIENT`

可以继续分析，但不足以行动。

---

## C. `SUFFICIENT_FOR_INFORMATION_GATHERING`

已经足够知道：

```
what we still need to learn
```

但不是足够决定。

例如：

```
need contract clarification
need professional review
need partner consent
```

---

## D. `SUFFICIENT_FOR_REVERSIBLE_ACTION`

信息仍不完整，但当前行动：

```
small
bounded
reversible
low impact
```

可以通过现实反馈继续学习。

---

## E. `SUFFICIENT_FOR_BOUNDED_ACTION`

可以执行一个明确范围、明确时间、明确退出条件的行动。

---

## F. `SUFFICIENT_FOR_HIGH_IMPACT_REVIEW`

重大行动已经接近充分，但还需要：

```
professional
shared-decision
consent
formal review
```

中的一个或多个完成。

---

## G. `DECISION_SUFFICIENT`

当前已知、未知与边界已经足够清楚，可以负责任地承担下一步。

注意：

```
DECISION_SUFFICIENT
≠
OUTCOME GUARANTEED
```

---

# 11. What Sufficiency Is Made Of

Decision Sufficiency 不应该压成一个神秘分数。

建议至少由以下维度共同构成：

```
OBJECT_CLARITY
POSITION_SUFFICIENCY
OPTION_SPACE_SUFFICIENCY
TIME_SUFFICIENCY
REVERSIBILITY_SUFFICIENCY
AUTHORITY_SUFFICIENCY
VALUE_SUFFICIENCY
MINIMUM_STATE_SUFFICIENCY
SCENARIO_SUFFICIENCY
RECOVERY_SUFFICIENCY
CRITICAL_UNKNOWN_STATE
```

但这些不应被简单平均。

---

# 12. `allowedInference`

NAV-26 可以：

## A. 判断仍有未知，但未知不再改变当前下一步

例如：

```
exact future salary unknown
```

但如果当前动作只是：

```
apply for three roles
```

那么这个未知可能不阻止行动。

可以标记：

```
UNKNOWN_NOT_ACTION_BLOCKING
```

---

## B. 判断某个未知仍然会改变整个决定

例如：

```
contract may contain RM200k termination liability
```

在尚未确认前可能属于：

```
CRITICAL_UNKNOWN
```

阻止重大执行。

---

## C. 判断当前信息只够做小动作

例如：

```
full relocation decision not sufficient
```

但：

```
visit location
speak to school
verify visa
```

已经足够。

可以输出：

```
SUFFICIENT_FOR_REVERSIBLE_ACTION
```

---

## D. 判断继续等待已经不会显著提高充分性

如果：

```
remaining unknowns
cannot reasonably be resolved before action
```

而：

```
minimum state protected
exit route ready
action reversible enough
```

则可以判断：

```
FURTHER_INFORMATION_HAS_LOW_DECISION_VALUE
```

---

## E. 判断“资料很多”仍然不足

例如：

```
10 reports
5 readings
long analysis
```

但：

```
cash flow unknown
decision owner unclear
partner consent missing
```

则仍然：

```
INSUFFICIENT
```

---

# 13. `forbiddenInference`

NAV-26 严禁：

## A. 把确定感当充分性

```
“I feel sure”
≠
DECISION_SUFFICIENT
```

---

## B. 把资料量当充分性

```
MORE DATA
≠
MORE SUFFICIENCY
```

---

## C. 把多方法一致当充分性

禁止：

```
BaZi + Zi Wei + Tarot + Astrology agree
→ decision sufficient
```

---

## D. 把专业意见当整个人生决定的充分性

专业人士只能提供其领域内的 authority。

---

## E. 因为时间紧就自动降低标准

```
urgent
≠
sufficient
```

---

## F. 因为不可能知道全部就放弃任何门槛

```
uncertainty unavoidable
≠
anything goes
```

---

# 14. `decisionEffect`

NAV-26 主要影响：

```
ACTION_ADMISSION
ACTION_SCALE
WAIT_ACT_BALANCE
ESCALATION_REQUIREMENT
INFORMATION_GATHERING_PRIORITY
FINAL_DECISION_READINESS
```

核心 effect：

```
DECISION_READINESS
```

---

# 15. `decisionThresholdEffect`

NAV-26 不建立最终统一 threshold 公式。

完整 threshold mechanics 由：

```
NAV-27
Impact / Reversibility Threshold
```

进一步处理。

NAV-26 负责回答：

> **目前的信息与现实理解，是否已经达到“可以进入某种等级行动”的充分状态？**

而 NAV-27 负责：

> **这类行动究竟需要多高程度的充分性？**

两者必须分开。

---

# 16. `authorityBoundary`

NAV-26 可以：

- 判断信息是否足够；
- 判断未知是否阻断；
- 判断下一步允许到什么规模；
- 判断是否需要继续补资料；
- 判断是否应进入专业 / shared review；
- 判断是否已经可以行动。

NAV-26 不可以：

- 宣称未来确定；
- 替用户作最终选择；
- 用解释性证据填补现实关键未知；
- 自动批准受监管行动；
- 自动越过 consent；
- 将“充分”解释成“正确”。

---

# 17. `humanDecisionBoundary`

Decision Sufficiency 与 Decision Choice 必须严格分开。

系统可以判断：

```
Option A is decision-sufficient for bounded action.
```

但不能因此输出：

```
Therefore choose A.
```

用户仍然可以：

```
choose A
choose B
wait
reject both
seek more information
```

只要不违反合法 authority / hard constraint。

因此冻结：

> **Sufficiency determines whether a decision can responsibly proceed; it does not determine which decision a person must choose.**

中文：

> **充分性决定的是一个决定是否已经可以负责任地向前推进，而不是一个人必须选择哪一个决定。**

---

# 18. `sourceSections`

主要来源：

```
Book VIII
15.41–15.50｜Deciding Under Unknown
```

尤其：

```
15.41｜我们永远不会知道全部
15.42｜未知不等于不能决定
15.43｜什么时候还需要更多资料
15.44｜什么时候更多资料已经不会改变决定
15.45｜可逆性会改变所需确定程度
15.46｜影响越大，所需充分程度越高
15.47｜影响别人，会改变你的决定权
15.48｜证据充分与决策充分不是同一件事
15.49｜什么时候必须把决定升级给别人
15.50｜已经知道得足够多，是什么意思
```

---

# 19. `relatedBookFoundations`

## Book VII｜Reality Observation

Book VII 拥有：

```
Evidence Sufficiency
Observation Boundary
Uncertainty
Knowledge State
```

NAV-26 必须严格区分：

```
EVIDENCE SUFFICIENCY
≠
DECISION SUFFICIENCY
```

一个 claim 可以：

```
evidence insufficient
```

但某个低风险 reversible action 仍然可能：

```
decision sufficient
```

反过来：

某个事实可能证据充分，但整个决定仍然不充分。

---

## Book III｜Reality Continuity

提供：

```
capacity
recovery
continuity condition
```

作为是否可承担下一步的重要现实基础。

---

# 20. `profileConsumer`

Profile 可帮助理解：

```
uncertainty tolerance
decision style
over-analysis tendency
impulsivity tendency
```

但这些只能作为：

```
DECISION_BEHAVIOR_CONTEXT
```

不能决定：

```
SUFFICIENT
```

---

# 21. `financialConsumer`

Financial 对重大 Decision Sufficiency 非常重要。

尤其：

```
usable liquidity
debt obligations
fixed commitments
dependants
runway
downside affordability
```

如果 Financial 是当前决定的关键现实面，而资料缺失，则：

```
critical financial unknown
```

可能直接阻断高影响行动。

---

# 22. `methodConsumer`

AST / BAZI / ZIWEI / NUM / HD / ECR / Tarot / I Ching：

可以：

```
add interpretive context
surface a question
highlight a possible tension
```

但不得：

```
close critical unknown
create factual sufficiency
raise decision authority
```

---

# 23. `currentRealityConsumer`

Current Reality 是 NAV-26 的主要 factual anchor。

至少应提供：

```
whatIsKnownNow
whatChanged
whatIsVerified
whatIsReported
whatRemainsUnknown
whatWouldActuallyChangeDecision
```

---

# 24. `runtimeConsumer`

NAV-26 可被：

```
My Reality Navigation
Career Navigation
Financial Navigation
Relationship Navigation
Estate Navigation
Structural Transition Planning
Professional Handoff
Scenario Runtime
Action Runtime
```

消费。

这是第一个应该明确输出：

```
CAN PROCEED?
AT WHAT SCALE?
WHAT STILL BLOCKS?
```

的核心 module。

---

# 25. `academyConsumer`

Academy 可投影为：

> **Decision sufficiency is not knowing everything. It is knowing enough to responsibly bear the next step.**

中文：

> **决策充分不是知道一切，而是已经知道得足够多，可以负责任地承担下一步。**

---

# 26. `revisionTriggers`

以下情况必须重开 NAV-26：

```
decisionObjectChanged
currentPositionChanged
criticalUnknownResolved
newCriticalUnknownAppeared
minimumStateChanged
reversibilityChanged
scenarioChanged
exitRouteChanged
recoveryCapacityChanged
authorityChanged
consentChanged
professionalInputArrived
optionScaleChanged
```

---

# 27. Canonical Decision Sufficiency Model

建议：

```
{
  "decisionSufficiencyId": "",
  "decisionObjectId": "",
  "optionId": "",
  "state": "INSUFFICIENT | PARTIALLY_SUFFICIENT | SUFFICIENT_FOR_INFORMATION_GATHERING | SUFFICIENT_FOR_REVERSIBLE_ACTION | SUFFICIENT_FOR_BOUNDED_ACTION | SUFFICIENT_FOR_HIGH_IMPACT_REVIEW | DECISION_SUFFICIENT | SUFFICIENCY_BLOCKED_BY_AUTHORITY | SUFFICIENCY_BLOCKED_BY_CRITICAL_UNKNOWN",
  "knowns": [],
  "materialUnknowns": [],
  "criticalUnknowns": [],
  "nonBlockingUnknowns": [],
  "minimumStateStatus": "",
  "reversibilityStatus": "",
  "scenarioStatus": "",
  "exitRecoveryStatus": "",
  "authorityStatus": "",
  "permittedActionScale": "",
  "remainingRequirements": [],
  "sources": [],
  "status": ""
}
```

---

# 28. Evidence Sufficiency vs Decision Sufficiency Rule

冻结：

```
EVIDENCE SUFFICIENCY
≠
DECISION SUFFICIENCY
```

正式规则：

> **Evidence sufficiency asks whether a claim is adequately supported. Decision sufficiency asks whether the decision-maker knows enough, despite remaining uncertainty, to responsibly bear the next step.**

中文：

> **证据充分问的是一个判断有没有得到足够支持；决策充分问的是，即使仍有未知，决定者是否已经知道得足够多，可以负责任地承担下一步。**

---

# 29. Unknown Classification Rule

所有 material unknown 应至少分类：

```
CRITICAL_UNKNOWN
ACTION_RELEVANT_UNKNOWN
NON_BLOCKING_UNKNOWN
UNRESOLVABLE_BEFORE_ACTION
```

---

## `CRITICAL_UNKNOWN`

如果未知答案不同，会改变：

```
option eligibility
hard minimum
authority
major cost
reversibility
```

则属于 critical。

---

## `ACTION_RELEVANT_UNKNOWN`

会改变 action scale 或 timing，但未必阻止所有行动。

---

## `NON_BLOCKING_UNKNOWN`

即使未知，当前下一步仍然合理。

---

## `UNRESOLVABLE_BEFORE_ACTION`

现实只能通过行动反馈知道。

这种未知特别适合与：

```
small reversible action
```

结合。

---

# 30. More Information Rule

继续搜集资料只有在：

```
new information
could materially change
decision / option / threshold / action scale
```

时才具有明显 Navigation 价值。

否则：

```
MORE INFORMATION
```

可能只是：

```
MORE DELAY
```

---

# 31. Information Value Rule

建议引入：

```
INFORMATION_VALUE
```

状态：

```
HIGH
MATERIAL
LOW
EXHAUSTED
UNKNOWN
```

但不需要将其量化成统一分数。

---

# 32. Information Saturation Rule

如果：

```
new reports
new searches
new readings
new analysis
```

反复没有改变：

```
option space
minimum state
critical unknowns
action scale
```

可以标记：

```
INFORMATION_SATURATION
```

这不代表：

```
all knowledge complete
```

只代表：

```
additional information currently has low marginal decision value
```

---

# 33. Analysis Paralysis Boundary

系统不能诊断：

```
analysis paralysis
```

但可以识别：

```
REPEATED_INFORMATION_GATHERING_WITHOUT_DECISION_RELEVANT_CHANGE
```

然后问：

> 新增资料现在究竟还准备改变哪个判断？

---

# 34. Action-as-Learning Rule

如果：

```
remaining unknown
cannot be resolved by more passive analysis
```

而存在：

```
bounded
reversible
low-impact
observable
```

行动，

Navigation 可以允许：

```
ACTION_FOR_INFORMATION
```

例如：

```
pilot
trial
conversation
application
short stay
small allocation
```

但仍须符合 domain safety。

---

# 35. Sufficiency Is Action-Scale Specific

冻结：

```
SUFFICIENT FOR X
```

而不是只有：

```
SUFFICIENT / NOT SUFFICIENT
```

例如：

```
sufficient to research
sufficient to apply
sufficient to test
not sufficient to resign
```

这是 NAV-26 最重要的 runtime 原则之一。

---

# 36. Small-Step Sufficiency Rule

如果重大行动不充分，不代表：

```
nothing can be done
```

Navigation 应检查：

```
what smaller action is already sufficient?
```

这与：

```
NAV-06 Reversibility
NAV-10 Response Level
```

直接连接。

---

# 37. High-Impact Sufficiency Rule

高影响方案必须特别检查：

```
hard minimum protected
authority clear
consent clear
critical unknowns bounded
downside tested
exit route ready
recovery capacity real
```

否则不能标记：

```
DECISION_SUFFICIENT
```

---

# 38. Sufficiency and Urgency Rule

当 deadline 临近时，可能出现：

```
time insufficient
+
decision still insufficient
```

系统不得假装充分。

可以选择：

```
decline
pause
escalate
take smaller reversible step
accept explicit residual uncertainty
```

具体取决于现实。

---

# 39. Sufficiency and Inaction Rule

不行动也需要充分性。

例如：

```
stay in current role for another year
```

如果 NAV-18 已显示高 Waiting Cost，继续等待本身不能逃避 NAV-26。

因此：

```
INACTION SUFFICIENCY
```

也应存在。

---

# 40. Sufficiency and Status Quo Rule

当前路径不能因为：

```
already operating
```

就被默认视为：

```
decision sufficient forever
```

一旦 NAV-09 / NAV-13 重开，继续路径也要重新通过 NAV-26。

---

# 41. Sufficiency and Shared Decision Rule

如果：

```
SHARED_DECISION
```

则：

```
one person feels ready
```

不等于：

```
decision sufficient
```

必须满足 NAV-08 的 shared authority / consent。

---

# 42. Sufficiency and Professional Review Rule

如果：

```
PROFESSIONAL_REQUIRED
```

则即使其他条件全部充分：

```
professional requirement unresolved
```

仍应：

```
SUFFICIENCY_BLOCKED_BY_AUTHORITY
```

---

# 43. Sufficiency and Scenario Rule

Scenario Space 的作用不是消灭未知。

它让系统知道：

```
what kinds of unknowns we can still carry
```

如果 Downside：

```
remains above minimum
```

未知可承担度提高。

如果 Downside：

```
breaches hard minimum
```

则需要更强 protection。

---

# 44. Sufficiency and Exit Rule

一个 option 如果：

```
uncertain
```

但：

```
strong exit
strong recovery
high reversibility
```

可能较早达到 bounded-action sufficiency。

相反：

```
uncertain
+
no exit
+
low reversibility
```

则需要更高门槛。

---

# 45. Sufficiency State Must Explain Why

系统不得只显示：

```
DECISION SUFFICIENT
```

必须至少给出：

```
what is known
what remains unknown
why the unknown is still bearable
what action scale is allowed
what would reopen the decision
```

---

# 46. Customer Projection Example

内部：

```
Decision:
Leave current role for independent consulting

Known:
current workload unsustainable at preferred level
12 months usable liquidity
minimum household floor confirmed
client pilot validated
exit / recovery route ready

Unknown:
exact time to stable consulting income
future market demand

State:
SUFFICIENT_FOR_BOUNDED_ACTION

Allowed scale:
begin staged transition

Not yet sufficient:
immediate full irreversible expansion
```

客户可以看到：

> **现在已经不是“资料够不够多”的问题，而是剩下的未知会不会改变你下一步能够承担什么。**
> 
> 目前你已经知道当前工作结构的问题在哪里，也确认了家庭最低财务边界、可用现金缓冲、一个可以测试的客户来源，以及如果独立收入没有按预期形成时怎样停止扩张并恢复就业。真正仍然不知道的，是收入什么时候能够稳定，以及未来市场会怎样变化；这两项未知很重要，却不一定必须在行动以前完全消失。
> 
> 因此目前的信息已经足够支持一个有边界、可复核的转换步骤，却还不足以把所有现有收入结构一次性撤掉并进行不可逆扩张。这里的“充分”不是说未来已经确定，而是下一步已经有能力被承担。

---

# 47. Customer Actions

允许：

```
Proceed with bounded action
Gather one more critical input
Reduce action scale
Request professional review
Confirm remaining unknown
Accept residual uncertainty
Wait with reason
Reopen decision
Continue
```

---

# 48. `status`

建议：

```
UNFORMED
PARTIAL
INSUFFICIENT
INFORMATION_GATHERING_SUFFICIENT
REVERSIBLE_ACTION_SUFFICIENT
BOUNDED_ACTION_SUFFICIENT
HIGH_IMPACT_REVIEW_READY
DECISION_SUFFICIENT
BLOCKED_BY_CRITICAL_UNKNOWN
BLOCKED_BY_AUTHORITY
REOPENED
```

---

# 49. Fail-Closed Conditions

以下情况不得进入 NAV-27：

```
decisionObjectNotConfirmed
criticalUnknownHidden
hardMinimumUnresolved
authorityUnclear
consentMissing
professionalRequirementIgnored
scenarioDownsideNotTested
exitRecoveryMissingForHighImpactAction
symbolicInterpretationUsedToCloseMaterialUnknown
currentPositionStale
decisionSufficiencyDeclaredFromConfidenceAlone
```

---

# 50. Canonical Runtime Rule

> **Navigation must determine whether enough is known to responsibly bear the next step without pretending that all uncertainty has disappeared.**

中文：

> **Navigation 必须判断当前是否已经知道得足够多，可以负责任地承担下一步，同时不能假装所有未知都已经消失。**

---

# 51. Canonical Sufficiency Rule

> **Decision sufficiency means enough knowledge, reality grounding, authority clarity, downside awareness, and recovery capacity for the scale of action being considered.**

中文：

> **决策充分意味着：针对正在考虑的行动规模，已经拥有足够的现实依据、权威清晰度、下行情景理解与恢复能力。**

---

# 52. Canonical Uncertainty Rule

> **Remaining uncertainty does not block a decision unless it can materially change eligibility, responsibility, minimum-state protection, or the scale of action that can be safely borne.**

中文：

> **剩余未知只有在可能实质改变选项资格、责任边界、最低状态保护或可承担行动规模时，才应该阻断决定。**

---

# 53. Canonical Information Rule

> **More information is valuable only while it can still materially change the decision.**

中文：

> **只有当新增信息仍可能实质改变决定时，继续获取更多信息才继续具有明显价值。**

---

# 54. Canonical Action-Scale Rule

> **A decision may be sufficient for a small reversible step while remaining insufficient for a large irreversible commitment.**

中文：

> **一个决定可以已经充分到足以支持一个小而可逆的步骤，同时仍然不足以支持一个巨大且难以撤回的承诺。**

---

# 55. Canonical Human Authority Rule

> **Navigation can judge whether a decision is sufficiently grounded to proceed; it does not acquire the right to make the decision because sufficiency has been reached.**

中文：

> **Navigation 可以判断一个决定是否已经获得足够现实基础继续推进，却不会因为“已经充分”就取得替人作决定的权利。**

---

# 56. Final Canonical Form

```
NAV-26
DECISION SUFFICIENCY
```

**Input**

```
Current Reality
+
Evidence
+
Material Unknowns
+
Values / Minimums
+
Scenarios
+
Reversibility
+
Exit / Recovery
+
Authority
```

**Process**

```
Ask:
What do we know?
What remains unknown?
Which unknowns can still change the decision?
What scale of action can current knowledge support?
What would still require more evidence, consent, or authority?
```

**Output**

```
Decision Sufficiency State
+
Permitted Action Scale
+
Remaining Blocking Conditions
```

**Boundary**

```
Enough is not everything.
Unknown is not automatically a reason to wait.
Sufficient does not mean certain.
Sufficient does not mean the system chooses.
```

modules.canonicalQuestion:
为什么一个小而可逆的行动，
可以在仍有较多未知时开始，
而一个高影响、低可逆的行动，
却必须在进入现实以前知道得更多？
modules.definition:
**Impact / Reversibility Threshold** 是 Navigation 对“不同规模、不同后果、不同可逆性的行动，究竟需要多高程度的 Decision Sufficiency 才能进入现实”进行正式分层的机制。

NAV-26 已经回答：

> **现在知道得够不够？**

NAV-27 进一步回答：

> **对于这个具体行动，‘够’究竟应该到什么程度？**

因为：

```
申请一个职位
```

与：

```
辞去唯一收入来源
```

不能使用同一个门槛；

```
试住一个城市两周
```

与：

```
卖掉住房并永久迁移
```

不能使用同一个门槛；

```
投入 RM1,000 做一个可停止测试
```

与：

```
承担长期高额债务
```

也不能因为它们都属于“同一个方向”就使用同样的充分性要求。

因此：

> **NAV-27 的核心不是让系统变得更保守，而是让决策门槛与行动真正可能造成的影响、可逆性、责任与恢复难度相匹配。**

---
modules.navigationMeaning:
如果所有行动都使用同一门槛，系统会出现两种相反错误。

第一种：

```
OVER-CAUTION
```

小而可逆的行动也要求接近完全确定，于是用户永远无法通过现实行动获得新信息。

第二种：

```
UNDER-CAUTION
```

高影响、不可逆行动也只需要和普通试验一样的证据，就可能让尚未解决的未知直接进入现实。

因此 NAV-27 建立：

```
Action
↓
Impact
+
Reversibility
+
Affected Parties
+
Minimum-State Exposure
+
Recovery Capacity
↓
Required Decision Threshold
```

换句话说：

> **不是所有未知都必须消失，但行动越可能留下无法撤回的后果，未知就越不能被轻易带入现实。**

---
modules.requiredInputs:
NAV-27 最低需要：

```
decisionSufficiencyState
candidateAction
actionScale
reversibilityProfile
minimumAcceptableState
authorityMap
affectedParties
exitRecoveryState
```

最好同时读取：

```
scenarioRobustness
capacityQualification
timeHorizonMap
waitingQualification
crossDomainPropagation
```

如果连行动规模或影响范围都没有定义，则：

```
THRESHOLD_UNFORMED
```

---
modules.optionalInputs:
```
financialNavigationProjection
currentRealityProjection
professionalInput
legalOrContractualContext
relationshipContext
sharedDecisionContext
careContext
institutionalContext
priorNavigationState
```

这些用于判断：

- 后果影响谁；
- 可否撤回；
- 是否会触及 hard minimum；
- 是否必须由专业人士确认；
- 是否需要共同决策。

---
modules.inputAuthorityClasses:
允许：

```
CURRENT_FACT
VERIFIED_RECORD
USER_REPORTED_CURRENT
PROFESSIONAL_INPUT
LEGAL_OR_CONTRACTUAL_RECORD
CONSENT_RECORD
SUPPORTED_INFERENCE
SCENARIO_ASSUMPTION
INTERPRETIVE_CONTEXT
UNKNOWN
```

其中：

```
IMPACT
REVERSIBILITY
AUTHORITY
MINIMUM_STATE
```

不能由 Symbolic Reading 单独建立。

---
modules.allowedInference:
NAV-27 可以：

## A. 因可逆性高而允许较低门槛

例如：

```
short pilot
```

即使未来需求尚未知，也可能：

```
T1 / T2
```

因为可以快速停止。

---

## B. 因跨领域影响提高门槛

例如：

```
relocation
```

同时影响：

```
career
housing
children
partner
financial
```

则不能只按“换地点”处理。

---

## C. 因 hard minimum 接近提高门槛

如果 Downside：

```
approaches minimum liquidity
```

则即使 Option 本身不是完全不可逆，也需要更强准备。

---

## D. 因恢复能力强而降低部分执行风险

例如：

```
high liquidity
clear re-employment route
strong exit
```

可以使某个中等影响行动更可承担。

但不能突破：

```
legal
consent
hard minimum
```

---

## E. 因行动规模缩小而降低 required threshold

例如：

```
full launch
→ pilot
```

可能从：

```
T4
```

降至：

```
T2
```

前提是现实影响真的缩小。

---
modules.forbiddenInference:
NAV-27 严禁：

## A. 把风险偏好当 threshold 本身

```
“I am willing to take risk”
≠
lower professional / consent requirement
```

---

## B. 因用户非常有信心降低高影响门槛

```
confidence
≠
sufficiency
```

---

## C. 因方法一致降低门槛

禁止：

```
BaZi + Tarot + Astrology agree
→ threshold lower
```

---

## D. 把金钱损失视为唯一 impact

影响还可能包括：

```
dependants
time
identity
housing
relationship
legal
health access
future options
```

---

## E. 把“可逆”自动当低影响

例如：

```
public disclosure
```

可能 technically retractable，但 reputation residue 很高。

---

## F. 用单一总分自动决定 threshold

NAV-27 不应成为：

```
Impact 80
Reversibility 20
Total = 62
```

这种黑箱评分器。

---
modules.decisionEffect:
NAV-27 主要影响：

```
REQUIRED_SUFFICIENCY_LEVEL
ACTION_ADMISSION
ACTION_SCALE
ESCALATION_REQUIREMENT
PROFESSIONAL_REQUIREMENT
CONSENT_REQUIREMENT
```

核心 effect：

```
THRESHOLD_MATCHING
```

---
modules.decisionThresholdEffect:
这是 NAV-27 本身的核心。

冻结基本关系：

```
Higher Impact
+
Lower Reversibility
+
More Affected Parties
+
Closer Minimum-State Exposure
+
Weaker Recovery
→ Higher Required Decision Sufficiency
```

但不是机械加总。

应保留：

```
RULE-BASED THRESHOLDING
```

而不是：

```
SCORE-BASED LIFE DECISION
```

---
modules.authorityBoundary:
NAV-27 可以：

- 判断需要多高充分性；
- 调整 action scale；
- 要求更多现实依据；
- 要求更强 exit/recovery；
- 要求专业确认；
- 要求 shared consent。

NAV-27 不可以：

- 替用户选方案；
- 把 threshold 变成概率；
- 伪造安全；
- 因用户愿意承担就绕过合法 authority；
- 用方法解释降低现实门槛。

---
modules.humanDecisionBoundary:
用户可以选择承担一个：

```
high-impact option
```

但只有在：

```
authority valid
hard constraints respected
critical unknowns appropriately bounded
```

的前提下。

系统应该表达：

> 这个决定仍然属于你，但因为它影响范围大、恢复成本高，所以我们需要比一个普通试验更完整地确认现实。

而不是：

> 系统不允许你做。

除非存在：

```
legal
safety
consent
professional
```

方面的真正阻断条件。

---
modules.sourceSections:
主要来源：

```
Book VIII
15.45｜可逆性会改变所需确定程度
15.46｜影响越大，所需充分程度越高

```

```
NAV-06 Reversibility
```

modules.relatedBookFoundations:

```
evidence boundary
uncertainty
knowledge state
```

但 NAV-27 不问：

> 证据够不够支持某个 claim？

它问：

> **对于这一级行动，我们究竟需要多高程度的充分性？**

---

提供：

```
capacity
recovery
```

用于判断高影响行动失败以后是否仍可恢复。

modules.profileConsumer:
Profile 可以提供：

```
risk tolerance
uncertainty tolerance
change preference
```

但只能作为：

```
PERSONAL_TOLERANCE_CONTEXT
```

不能改变：

```
legal threshold
consent threshold
material hard minimum
```

---
modules.financialConsumer:
Financial 对：

```
IMPACT_MAGNITUDE
MINIMUM_STATE_EXPOSURE
RECOVERY_CAPACITY
```

尤其重要。

例如：

```
RM5k reversible pilot
```

与：

```
RM500k illiquid commitment
```

不能用同一门槛。

---
modules.methodConsumer:
所有 Methods：

```
AST
BAZI
ZIWEI
NUM
HD
ECR
Tarot
I Ching
```

都不得影响：

```
REQUIRED_SUFFICIENCY_LEVEL
```

最多只能：

```
surface questions
```

---
modules.currentRealityConsumer:
Current Reality 应至少提供：

```
actual impact scope
affected domains
current responsibilities
current buffers
current recovery capacity
actual affected parties
```

这些才是 threshold 的现实基础。

---
modules.runtimeConsumer:
NAV-27 可被：

```
My Reality Navigation
Career Navigation
Financial Navigation
Relationship Navigation
Estate Navigation
Structural Transition Planning
Professional Handoff
Action Runtime
```

消费。

它应成为所有 action proposal 的：

```
THRESHOLD GATE
```

modules.academyConsumer:
Academy 可投影为：

> **The larger the consequence and the harder the reversal, the more you need to know before acting.**

中文：

> **后果越大、越难回头，行动以前就越需要知道得更多。**

```
scenarioChanged
```
