canonicalSections.heading: Core Threshold Levels
canonicalSections.body:
建议不要直接建立一个 0–100 总分。

至少区分：

```
T1_LOW
T2_MODERATE
T3_HIGH
T4_VERY_HIGH
T5_FORMAL_OR_PROFESSIONAL_GATE
```

这些不是风险等级标签，而是：

> **进入行动以前，需要达到的充分性强度。**

---

## A. `T1_LOW`

适用于：

```
low impact
highly reversible
low cost
few affected parties
strong ability to stop
```

例如：

```
submit application
try one class
conduct small pilot
have exploratory conversation
```

仍然需要现实边界，但允许通过行动学习。

---

## B. `T2_MODERATE`

行动有一定：

```
cost
time
commitment
other-party effect
```

但仍可较容易调整。

例如：

```
short-term training
limited paid pilot
temporary schedule change
small allocation
```

---

## C. `T3_HIGH`

行动会明显改变：

```
income
housing
career structure
family arrangement
significant capital
```

而退出需要真实成本。

要求更清楚的：

```
minimum state
downside
exit route
recovery capacity
```

---

## D. `T4_VERY_HIGH`

适用于：

```
major irreversible or hard-to-reverse change
high financial exposure
deep cross-domain consequence
significant dependant impact
long-term lock-in
```

需要：

```
strong current reality basis
critical unknowns bounded
minimum state protected
authority clear
recovery route credible
```

---

## E. `T5_FORMAL_OR_PROFESSIONAL_GATE`

当行动进入：

```
medical
legal
regulated financial
formal consent
institutional authorization
```

等领域时，

门槛不只是“更高”，而是：

```
different authority path
```

即必须经过：

```
PROFESSIONAL_REQUIRED
CONSENT_REQUIRED
FORMAL_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Core Threshold Drivers
canonicalSections.body:
至少应检查：

```
IMPACT_MAGNITUDE
REVERSIBILITY
AFFECTED_PARTIES
MINIMUM_STATE_EXPOSURE
RECOVERY_DIFFICULTY
TIME_HORIZON
CAPACITY_CONSUMPTION
LEGAL_OR_PROFESSIONAL_REQUIREMENT
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: `allowedInference`
canonicalSections.body:
NAV-27 可以：

## A. 因可逆性高而允许较低门槛

例如：

```
short pilot
```

即使未来需求尚未知，也可能：

```
T1 / T2
```

因为可以快速停止。

---

## B. 因跨领域影响提高门槛

例如：

```
relocation
```

同时影响：

```
career
housing
children
partner
financial
```

则不能只按“换地点”处理。

---

## C. 因 hard minimum 接近提高门槛

如果 Downside：

```
approaches minimum liquidity
```

则即使 Option 本身不是完全不可逆，也需要更强准备。

---

## D. 因恢复能力强而降低部分执行风险

例如：

```
high liquidity
clear re-employment route
strong exit
```

可以使某个中等影响行动更可承担。

但不能突破：

```
legal
consent
hard minimum
```

---

## E. 因行动规模缩小而降低 required threshold

例如：

```
full launch
→ pilot
```

可能从：

```
T4
```

降至：

```
T2
```

前提是现实影响真的缩小。

---

canonicalSections.heading: `forbiddenInference`
canonicalSections.body:
NAV-27 严禁：

## A. 把风险偏好当 threshold 本身

```
“I am willing to take risk”
≠
lower professional / consent requirement
```

---

## B. 因用户非常有信心降低高影响门槛

```
confidence
≠
sufficiency
```

---

## C. 因方法一致降低门槛

禁止：

```
BaZi + Tarot + Astrology agree
→ threshold lower
```

---

## D. 把金钱损失视为唯一 impact

影响还可能包括：

```
dependants
time
identity
housing
relationship
legal
health access
future options
```

---

## E. 把“可逆”自动当低影响

例如：

```
public disclosure
```

可能 technically retractable，但 reputation residue 很高。

---

## F. 用单一总分自动决定 threshold

NAV-27 不应成为：

```
Impact 80
Reversibility 20
Total = 62
```

这种黑箱评分器。

---

canonicalSections.heading: `decisionEffect`
canonicalSections.body:
NAV-27 主要影响：

```
REQUIRED_SUFFICIENCY_LEVEL
ACTION_ADMISSION
ACTION_SCALE
ESCALATION_REQUIREMENT
PROFESSIONAL_REQUIREMENT
CONSENT_REQUIREMENT
```

核心 effect：

```
THRESHOLD_MATCHING
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: `decisionThresholdEffect`
canonicalSections.body:
这是 NAV-27 本身的核心。

冻结基本关系：

```
Higher Impact
+
Lower Reversibility
+
More Affected Parties
+
Closer Minimum-State Exposure
+
Weaker Recovery
→ Higher Required Decision Sufficiency
```

但不是机械加总。

应保留：

```
RULE-BASED THRESHOLDING
```

而不是：

```
SCORE-BASED LIFE DECISION
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: `authorityBoundary`
canonicalSections.body:
NAV-27 可以：

- 判断需要多高充分性；
- 调整 action scale；
- 要求更多现实依据；
- 要求更强 exit/recovery；
- 要求专业确认；
- 要求 shared consent。

NAV-27 不可以：

- 替用户选方案；
- 把 threshold 变成概率；
- 伪造安全；
- 因用户愿意承担就绕过合法 authority；
- 用方法解释降低现实门槛。

---

canonicalSections.heading: `humanDecisionBoundary`
canonicalSections.body:
用户可以选择承担一个：

```
high-impact option
```

但只有在：

```
authority valid
hard constraints respected
critical unknowns appropriately bounded
```

的前提下。

系统应该表达：

> 这个决定仍然属于你，但因为它影响范围大、恢复成本高，所以我们需要比一个普通试验更完整地确认现实。

而不是：

> 系统不允许你做。

除非存在：

```
legal
safety
consent
professional
```

方面的真正阻断条件。

---

canonicalSections.heading: `sourceSections`
canonicalSections.body:
主要来源：

```
Book VIII
15.45｜可逆性会改变所需确定程度
15.46｜影响越大，所需充分程度越高
15.47｜影响别人，会改变你的决定权
15.49｜什么时候必须把决定升级给别人
```

同时直接消费：

```
NAV-06 Reversibility
NAV-08 Navigation Authority
NAV-22 Minimum Acceptable State
NAV-25 Exit / Recovery Route
NAV-26 Decision Sufficiency
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: `relatedBookFoundations`
canonicalSections.body:
## Book VII｜Reality Observation

提供：

```
evidence boundary
uncertainty
knowledge state
```

但 NAV-27 不问：

> 证据够不够支持某个 claim？

它问：

> **对于这一级行动，我们究竟需要多高程度的充分性？**

---

## Book III｜Reality Continuity

提供：

```
capacity
recovery
continuity consequence
```

用于判断高影响行动失败以后是否仍可恢复。

---

canonicalSections.heading: `profileConsumer`
canonicalSections.body:
Profile 可以提供：

```
risk tolerance
uncertainty tolerance
change preference
```

但只能作为：

```
PERSONAL_TOLERANCE_CONTEXT
```

不能改变：

```
legal threshold
consent threshold
material hard minimum
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: `financialConsumer`
canonicalSections.body:
Financial 对：

```
IMPACT_MAGNITUDE
MINIMUM_STATE_EXPOSURE
RECOVERY_CAPACITY
```

尤其重要。

例如：

```
RM5k reversible pilot
```

与：

```
RM500k illiquid commitment
```

不能用同一门槛。

---

canonicalSections.heading: `methodConsumer`
canonicalSections.body:
所有 Methods：

```
AST
BAZI
ZIWEI
NUM
HD
ECR
Tarot
I Ching
```

都不得影响：

```
REQUIRED_SUFFICIENCY_LEVEL
```

最多只能：

```
surface questions
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: `currentRealityConsumer`
canonicalSections.body:
Current Reality 应至少提供：

```
actual impact scope
affected domains
current responsibilities
current buffers
current recovery capacity
actual affected parties
```

这些才是 threshold 的现实基础。

---

canonicalSections.heading: `runtimeConsumer`
canonicalSections.body:
NAV-27 可被：

```
My Reality Navigation
Career Navigation
Financial Navigation
Relationship Navigation
Estate Navigation
Structural Transition Planning
Professional Handoff
Action Runtime
```

消费。

它应成为所有 action proposal 的：

```
THRESHOLD GATE
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: `academyConsumer`
canonicalSections.body:
Academy 可投影为：

> **The larger the consequence and the harder the reversal, the more you need to know before acting.**

中文：

> **后果越大、越难回头，行动以前就越需要知道得更多。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: `revisionTriggers`
canonicalSections.body:
以下情况必须重开 NAV-27：

```
actionScaleChanged
reversibilityChanged
affectedPartyChanged
minimumStateChanged
recoveryCapacityChanged
financialExposureChanged
authorityChanged
consentChanged
professionalRequirementChanged
scenarioChanged
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Canonical Threshold Model
canonicalSections.body:
建议：

```
{
  "thresholdAssessmentId": "",
  "decisionObjectId": "",
  "actionId": "",
  "drivers": {
    "impactMagnitude": "",
    "reversibility": "",
    "affectedParties": [],
    "minimumStateExposure": "",
    "recoveryDifficulty": "",
    "timeHorizon": "",
    "capacityConsumption": "",
    "authorityRequirement": ""
  },
  "requiredThreshold": "T1_LOW | T2_MODERATE | T3_HIGH | T4_VERY_HIGH | T5_FORMAL_OR_PROFESSIONAL_GATE",
  "currentSufficiencyState": "",
  "thresholdMet": false,
  "remainingRequirements": [],
  "status": ""
}
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Threshold Is Action-Specific
canonicalSections.body:
冻结：

```
THRESHOLD belongs to ACTION
not to PERSON
```

同一个人可以对：

```
apply for role
```

达到充分，

却对：

```
quit current role immediately
```

仍不充分。

因此不能给用户贴：

```
ready / not ready
```

这种全局标签。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Threshold Is Not Courage
canonicalSections.body:
高 threshold 不意味着：

```
fearful
conservative
weak
```

低 threshold 也不意味着：

```
brave
decisive
```

它只是行动结构。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Impact Rule
canonicalSections.body:
Impact 应至少考虑：

```
magnitude
duration
number of affected domains
number of affected people
difficulty of repair
```

不是只看 immediate size。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Reversibility Rule
canonicalSections.body:
必须读取 NAV-06：

```
HIGHLY_REVERSIBLE
REVERSIBLE_WITH_COST
PARTIALLY_REVERSIBLE
LOW_REVERSIBILITY
EFFECTIVELY_IRREVERSIBLE
```

并加入：

```
residual effects
```

而不是只问：

> 能不能撤销？

---

canonicalSections.heading: Affected-Party Rule
canonicalSections.body:
如果行动主要影响用户本人：

```
threshold may remain individual
```

如果明显影响：

```
partner
children
dependants
employees
co-owner
```

则 threshold 还必须包含：

```
authority
consent
shared responsibility
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Minimum-State Exposure Rule
canonicalSections.body:
建议状态：

```
FAR_ABOVE_MINIMUM
ABOVE_MINIMUM
NEAR_MINIMUM
POSSIBLE_BREACH
LIKELY_BREACH
UNKNOWN
```

越接近 minimum，所需准备越强。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Recovery Difficulty Rule
canonicalSections.body:
建议：

```
EASY_RECOVERY
MODERATE_RECOVERY
DIFFICULT_RECOVERY
RECOVERY_UNCERTAIN
RECOVERY_NOT_ESTABLISHED
```

但不能用简单 numerical score 合并。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Threshold and Small Experiment
canonicalSections.body:
如果：

```
full action = T4
```

而：

```
small pilot = T1/T2
```

Navigation 应允许：

```
SMALLER_ACTION_ADMISSION
```

从现实中学习。

这不是逃避大决定，而是：

```
reduce consequence while learning
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Threshold and Delay
canonicalSections.body:
如果 Action 尚未达到 required threshold：

```
WAIT
```

也不一定是答案。

可以：

```
gather critical information
reduce scale
increase buffer
obtain consent
seek professional review
build exit route
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Threshold and Urgency
canonicalSections.body:
可能出现：

```
Urgent
+
High Threshold
+
Incomplete Information
```

系统不能偷偷把 threshold 降低。

应考虑：

```
professional escalation
minimal reversible action
decline option
temporary safeguard
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Threshold and Optionality
canonicalSections.body:
如果方案保留：

```
future options
exit routes
recovery capacity
```

即使影响不小，也可能更可承担。

但 optionality 不能补偿：

```
hard minimum violation
consent violation
legal requirement
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Threshold and Interpretation
canonicalSections.body:
冻结：

> **Interpretive confidence does not reduce the threshold required by material impact and irreversibility.**

中文：

> **解释上的确信，不能降低现实影响与不可逆性所要求的决策门槛。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: Threshold and Professional Input
canonicalSections.body:
专业意见可以：

```
reduce domain uncertainty
clarify formal requirements
improve recovery design
```

但仍不自动选择人生方向。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Threshold Met Rule
canonicalSections.body:
只有当：

```
currentDecisionSufficiency
```

达到或超过：

```
requiredThreshold
```

并且：

```
authority requirements satisfied
hard minimum not violated
```

才可：

```
THRESHOLD_MET
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Threshold Not Met Rule
canonicalSections.body:
如果：

```
THRESHOLD_NOT_MET
```

必须输出：

```
what is missing
why it matters
what smaller action may still qualify
```

不能只说：

> 信息不足。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Customer Projection Example
canonicalSections.body:
内部：

```
Action A:
Apply for consulting roles

Impact:
low

Reversibility:
high

Required threshold:
T1

Current sufficiency:
met

Action B:
Resign immediately

Impact:
high

Reversibility:
partial

Affected:
household

Minimum-state exposure:
near financial floor

Recovery:
available but uncertain

Required threshold:
T4

Current sufficiency:
not yet met
```

客户可以看到：

> **现在不是“这个方向能不能开始”的单一问题，而是不同动作需要不同程度的确定。**
> 
> 你已经知道得足够多，可以开始申请、测试客户需求、建立第二收入来源，这些步骤的成本有限，而且容易停止；但“立刻辞去唯一收入来源”是另一种等级的决定，它会直接影响家庭现金流，也会明显缩小恢复空间，因此需要更高程度的充分性。
> 
> 换句话说，目前不是“不能前进”，而是已经可以前进到较小、可逆的那一步，却还没有足够现实基础跨过最大的承诺。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Customer Actions
canonicalSections.body:
允许：

```
Proceed at current scale
Reduce action scale
Increase buffer
Resolve critical unknown
Request consent
Request professional review
Strengthen exit route
Wait with explicit reason
Reassess threshold
Continue
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: `status`
canonicalSections.body:
建议：

```
UNFORMED
PARTIAL
THRESHOLD_T1
THRESHOLD_T2
THRESHOLD_T3
THRESHOLD_T4
FORMAL_GATE_REQUIRED
THRESHOLD_MET
THRESHOLD_NOT_MET
REDUCED_ACTION_AVAILABLE
ESCALATION_REQUIRED
REOPENED
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Fail-Closed Conditions
canonicalSections.body:
以下情况不得进入 NAV-28：

```
actionScaleUndefined
impactUnderstated
reversibilityMissing
affectedPartyIgnored
minimumStateExposureUnknownForHighImpactAction
recoveryRouteMissing
authorityRequirementIgnored
consentRequirementIgnored
symbolicReadingUsedToLowerThreshold
thresholdMetDeclaredFromConfidenceAlone
decisionObjectChanged
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Canonical Runtime Rule
canonicalSections.body:
> **Navigation must match the required level of decision sufficiency to the impact, reversibility, responsibility, and recovery burden of the specific action being considered.**

中文：

> **Navigation 必须让所需决策充分程度，与正在考虑的具体行动之影响、可逆性、责任范围与恢复负担相匹配。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: Canonical Scale Rule
canonicalSections.body:
> **A decision may fail the threshold for a large action while passing the threshold for a smaller reversible action.**

中文：

> **一个决定可以尚未达到重大行动的门槛，却已经达到较小、可逆行动的门槛。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: Canonical Impact Rule
canonicalSections.body:
> **Higher consequence requires stronger grounding; urgency does not erase that requirement.**

中文：

> **后果越大，需要的现实基础越强；紧迫性不会自动取消这项要求。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: Canonical Reversibility Rule
canonicalSections.body:
> **Reversibility lowers the cost of being wrong; it does not make evidence, responsibility, or minimum-state protection irrelevant.**

中文：

> **可逆性降低的是判断错误以后付出的代价，却不会让证据、责任与最低状态保护变得不重要。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: Canonical Non-Scoring Rule
canonicalSections.body:
> **Impact and reversibility must shape the threshold without collapsing human decisions into a single weighted score.**

中文：

> **影响与可逆性必须真正改变决策门槛，却不能因此把人的决定压成一个加权总分。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: Canonical Authority Rule
canonicalSections.body:
> **Where law, consent, professional responsibility, or legitimate shared authority governs the action, higher confidence cannot substitute for the required authority.**

中文：

> **当法律、同意、专业责任或合法共同权威对行动具有正式约束时，再高的确信程度都不能取代真正需要的权威。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: Final Canonical Form
canonicalSections.body:
```
NAV-27
IMPACT / REVERSIBILITY THRESHOLD
```

**Input**

```
Decision Sufficiency State
+
Specific Action
+
Impact
+
Reversibility
+
Affected Parties
+
Minimum-State Exposure
+
Recovery Capacity
```

**Process**

```
Determine:
How big is the consequence?
How difficult is reversal?
Who else is affected?
How close is downside to the floor?
How recoverable is failure?
What authority is required?
What sufficiency level does this action require?
```

**Output**

```
Required Decision Threshold
+
Threshold-Met State
+
Allowed Action Scale
+
Remaining Requirements
```

**Boundary**

```
The threshold belongs to the action, not the person.
Smaller action may qualify before larger commitment.
Confidence cannot substitute for reality.
```

modules.canonicalText:
# NAV-27｜Impact / Reversibility Threshold

## 影响 / 可逆性门槛｜影响越大、越难回头，需要知道到什么程度

**Canonical Question｜规范问题**

> **为什么一个小而可逆的行动，可以在仍有较多未知时开始，而一个高影响、低可逆的行动，却必须在进入现实以前知道得更多？**

---

## 1. `moduleId`

```
NAV-27
```

## 2. `canonicalTitleZh`

```
影响 / 可逆性门槛
```

## 3. `canonicalTitleEn`

```
Impact / Reversibility Threshold
```

## 4. `canonicalQuestion`

```
为什么一个小而可逆的行动，
可以在仍有较多未知时开始，
而一个高影响、低可逆的行动，
却必须在进入现实以前知道得更多？
```

---

# 5. `definition`

**Impact / Reversibility Threshold** 是 Navigation 对“不同规模、不同后果、不同可逆性的行动，究竟需要多高程度的 Decision Sufficiency 才能进入现实”进行正式分层的机制。

NAV-26 已经回答：

> **现在知道得够不够？**

NAV-27 进一步回答：

> **对于这个具体行动，‘够’究竟应该到什么程度？**

因为：

```
申请一个职位
```

与：

```
辞去唯一收入来源
```

不能使用同一个门槛；

```
试住一个城市两周
```

与：

```
卖掉住房并永久迁移
```

不能使用同一个门槛；

```
投入 RM1,000 做一个可停止测试
```

与：

```
承担长期高额债务
```

也不能因为它们都属于“同一个方向”就使用同样的充分性要求。

因此：

> **NAV-27 的核心不是让系统变得更保守，而是让决策门槛与行动真正可能造成的影响、可逆性、责任与恢复难度相匹配。**

---

# 6. `navigationMeaning`

如果所有行动都使用同一门槛，系统会出现两种相反错误。

第一种：

```
OVER-CAUTION
```

小而可逆的行动也要求接近完全确定，于是用户永远无法通过现实行动获得新信息。

第二种：

```
UNDER-CAUTION
```

高影响、不可逆行动也只需要和普通试验一样的证据，就可能让尚未解决的未知直接进入现实。

因此 NAV-27 建立：

```
Action
↓
Impact
+
Reversibility
+
Affected Parties
+
Minimum-State Exposure
+
Recovery Capacity
↓
Required Decision Threshold
```

换句话说：

> **不是所有未知都必须消失，但行动越可能留下无法撤回的后果，未知就越不能被轻易带入现实。**

---

# 7. `requiredInputs`

NAV-27 最低需要：

```
decisionSufficiencyState
candidateAction
actionScale
reversibilityProfile
minimumAcceptableState
authorityMap
affectedParties
exitRecoveryState
```

最好同时读取：

```
scenarioRobustness
capacityQualification
timeHorizonMap
waitingQualification
crossDomainPropagation
```

如果连行动规模或影响范围都没有定义，则：

```
THRESHOLD_UNFORMED
```

---

# 8. `optionalInputs`

```
financialNavigationProjection
currentRealityProjection
professionalInput
legalOrContractualContext
relationshipContext
sharedDecisionContext
careContext
institutionalContext
priorNavigationState
```

这些用于判断：

- 后果影响谁；
- 可否撤回；
- 是否会触及 hard minimum；
- 是否必须由专业人士确认；
- 是否需要共同决策。

---

# 9. `inputAuthorityClasses`

允许：

```
CURRENT_FACT
VERIFIED_RECORD
USER_REPORTED_CURRENT
PROFESSIONAL_INPUT
LEGAL_OR_CONTRACTUAL_RECORD
CONSENT_RECORD
SUPPORTED_INFERENCE
SCENARIO_ASSUMPTION
INTERPRETIVE_CONTEXT
UNKNOWN
```

其中：

```
IMPACT
REVERSIBILITY
AUTHORITY
MINIMUM_STATE
```

不能由 Symbolic Reading 单独建立。

---

# 10. Core Threshold Levels

建议不要直接建立一个 0–100 总分。

至少区分：

```
T1_LOW
T2_MODERATE
T3_HIGH
T4_VERY_HIGH
T5_FORMAL_OR_PROFESSIONAL_GATE
```

这些不是风险等级标签，而是：

> **进入行动以前，需要达到的充分性强度。**

---

## A. `T1_LOW`

适用于：

```
low impact
highly reversible
low cost
few affected parties
strong ability to stop
```

例如：

```
submit application
try one class
conduct small pilot
have exploratory conversation
```

仍然需要现实边界，但允许通过行动学习。

---

## B. `T2_MODERATE`

行动有一定：

```
cost
time
commitment
other-party effect
```

但仍可较容易调整。

例如：

```
short-term training
limited paid pilot
temporary schedule change
small allocation
```

---

## C. `T3_HIGH`

行动会明显改变：

```
income
housing
career structure
family arrangement
significant capital
```

而退出需要真实成本。

要求更清楚的：

```
minimum state
downside
exit route
recovery capacity
```

---

## D. `T4_VERY_HIGH`

适用于：

```
major irreversible or hard-to-reverse change
high financial exposure
deep cross-domain consequence
significant dependant impact
long-term lock-in
```

需要：

```
strong current reality basis
critical unknowns bounded
minimum state protected
authority clear
recovery route credible
```

---

## E. `T5_FORMAL_OR_PROFESSIONAL_GATE`

当行动进入：

```
medical
legal
regulated financial
formal consent
institutional authorization
```

等领域时，

门槛不只是“更高”，而是：

```
different authority path
```

即必须经过：

```
PROFESSIONAL_REQUIRED
CONSENT_REQUIRED
FORMAL_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED
```

---

# 11. Core Threshold Drivers

至少应检查：

```
IMPACT_MAGNITUDE
REVERSIBILITY
AFFECTED_PARTIES
MINIMUM_STATE_EXPOSURE
RECOVERY_DIFFICULTY
TIME_HORIZON
CAPACITY_CONSUMPTION
LEGAL_OR_PROFESSIONAL_REQUIREMENT
```

---

# 12. `allowedInference`

NAV-27 可以：

## A. 因可逆性高而允许较低门槛

例如：

```
short pilot
```

即使未来需求尚未知，也可能：

```
T1 / T2
```

因为可以快速停止。

---

## B. 因跨领域影响提高门槛

例如：

```
relocation
```

同时影响：

```
career
housing
children
partner
financial
```

则不能只按“换地点”处理。

---

## C. 因 hard minimum 接近提高门槛

如果 Downside：

```
approaches minimum liquidity
```

则即使 Option 本身不是完全不可逆，也需要更强准备。

---

## D. 因恢复能力强而降低部分执行风险

例如：

```
high liquidity
clear re-employment route
strong exit
```

可以使某个中等影响行动更可承担。

但不能突破：

```
legal
consent
hard minimum
```

---

## E. 因行动规模缩小而降低 required threshold

例如：

```
full launch
→ pilot
```

可能从：

```
T4
```

降至：

```
T2
```

前提是现实影响真的缩小。

---

# 13. `forbiddenInference`

NAV-27 严禁：

## A. 把风险偏好当 threshold 本身

```
“I am willing to take risk”
≠
lower professional / consent requirement
```

---

## B. 因用户非常有信心降低高影响门槛

```
confidence
≠
sufficiency
```

---

## C. 因方法一致降低门槛

禁止：

```
BaZi + Tarot + Astrology agree
→ threshold lower
```

---

## D. 把金钱损失视为唯一 impact

影响还可能包括：

```
dependants
time
identity
housing
relationship
legal
health access
future options
```

---

## E. 把“可逆”自动当低影响

例如：

```
public disclosure
```

可能 technically retractable，但 reputation residue 很高。

---

## F. 用单一总分自动决定 threshold

NAV-27 不应成为：

```
Impact 80
Reversibility 20
Total = 62
```

这种黑箱评分器。

---

# 14. `decisionEffect`

NAV-27 主要影响：

```
REQUIRED_SUFFICIENCY_LEVEL
ACTION_ADMISSION
ACTION_SCALE
ESCALATION_REQUIREMENT
PROFESSIONAL_REQUIREMENT
CONSENT_REQUIREMENT
```

核心 effect：

```
THRESHOLD_MATCHING
```

---

# 15. `decisionThresholdEffect`

这是 NAV-27 本身的核心。

冻结基本关系：

```
Higher Impact
+
Lower Reversibility
+
More Affected Parties
+
Closer Minimum-State Exposure
+
Weaker Recovery
→ Higher Required Decision Sufficiency
```

但不是机械加总。

应保留：

```
RULE-BASED THRESHOLDING
```

而不是：

```
SCORE-BASED LIFE DECISION
```

---

# 16. `authorityBoundary`

NAV-27 可以：

- 判断需要多高充分性；
- 调整 action scale；
- 要求更多现实依据；
- 要求更强 exit/recovery；
- 要求专业确认；
- 要求 shared consent。

NAV-27 不可以：

- 替用户选方案；
- 把 threshold 变成概率；
- 伪造安全；
- 因用户愿意承担就绕过合法 authority；
- 用方法解释降低现实门槛。

---

# 17. `humanDecisionBoundary`

用户可以选择承担一个：

```
high-impact option
```

但只有在：

```
authority valid
hard constraints respected
critical unknowns appropriately bounded
```

的前提下。

系统应该表达：

> 这个决定仍然属于你，但因为它影响范围大、恢复成本高，所以我们需要比一个普通试验更完整地确认现实。

而不是：

> 系统不允许你做。

除非存在：

```
legal
safety
consent
professional
```

方面的真正阻断条件。

---

# 18. `sourceSections`

主要来源：

```
Book VIII
15.45｜可逆性会改变所需确定程度
15.46｜影响越大，所需充分程度越高
15.47｜影响别人，会改变你的决定权
15.49｜什么时候必须把决定升级给别人
```

同时直接消费：

```
NAV-06 Reversibility
NAV-08 Navigation Authority
NAV-22 Minimum Acceptable State
NAV-25 Exit / Recovery Route
NAV-26 Decision Sufficiency
```

---

# 19. `relatedBookFoundations`

## Book VII｜Reality Observation

提供：

```
evidence boundary
uncertainty
knowledge state
```

但 NAV-27 不问：

> 证据够不够支持某个 claim？

它问：

> **对于这一级行动，我们究竟需要多高程度的充分性？**

---

## Book III｜Reality Continuity

提供：

```
capacity
recovery
continuity consequence
```

用于判断高影响行动失败以后是否仍可恢复。

---

# 20. `profileConsumer`

Profile 可以提供：

```
risk tolerance
uncertainty tolerance
change preference
```

但只能作为：

```
PERSONAL_TOLERANCE_CONTEXT
```

不能改变：

```
legal threshold
consent threshold
material hard minimum
```

---

# 21. `financialConsumer`

Financial 对：

```
IMPACT_MAGNITUDE
MINIMUM_STATE_EXPOSURE
RECOVERY_CAPACITY
```

尤其重要。

例如：

```
RM5k reversible pilot
```

与：

```
RM500k illiquid commitment
```

不能用同一门槛。

---

# 22. `methodConsumer`

所有 Methods：

```
AST
BAZI
ZIWEI
NUM
HD
ECR
Tarot
I Ching
```

都不得影响：

```
REQUIRED_SUFFICIENCY_LEVEL
```

最多只能：

```
surface questions
```

---

# 23. `currentRealityConsumer`

Current Reality 应至少提供：

```
actual impact scope
affected domains
current responsibilities
current buffers
current recovery capacity
actual affected parties
```

这些才是 threshold 的现实基础。

---

# 24. `runtimeConsumer`

NAV-27 可被：

```
My Reality Navigation
Career Navigation
Financial Navigation
Relationship Navigation
Estate Navigation
Structural Transition Planning
Professional Handoff
Action Runtime
```

消费。

它应成为所有 action proposal 的：

```
THRESHOLD GATE
```

---

# 25. `academyConsumer`

Academy 可投影为：

> **The larger the consequence and the harder the reversal, the more you need to know before acting.**

中文：

> **后果越大、越难回头，行动以前就越需要知道得更多。**

---

# 26. `revisionTriggers`

以下情况必须重开 NAV-27：

```
actionScaleChanged
reversibilityChanged
affectedPartyChanged
minimumStateChanged
recoveryCapacityChanged
financialExposureChanged
authorityChanged
consentChanged
professionalRequirementChanged
scenarioChanged
```

---

# 27. Canonical Threshold Model

建议：

```
{
  "thresholdAssessmentId": "",
  "decisionObjectId": "",
  "actionId": "",
  "drivers": {
    "impactMagnitude": "",
    "reversibility": "",
    "affectedParties": [],
    "minimumStateExposure": "",
    "recoveryDifficulty": "",
    "timeHorizon": "",
    "capacityConsumption": "",
    "authorityRequirement": ""
  },
  "requiredThreshold": "T1_LOW | T2_MODERATE | T3_HIGH | T4_VERY_HIGH | T5_FORMAL_OR_PROFESSIONAL_GATE",
  "currentSufficiencyState": "",
  "thresholdMet": false,
  "remainingRequirements": [],
  "status": ""
}
```

---

# 28. Threshold Is Action-Specific

冻结：

```
THRESHOLD belongs to ACTION
not to PERSON
```

同一个人可以对：

```
apply for role
```

达到充分，

却对：

```
quit current role immediately
```

仍不充分。

因此不能给用户贴：

```
ready / not ready
```

这种全局标签。

---

# 29. Threshold Is Not Courage

高 threshold 不意味着：

```
fearful
conservative
weak
```

低 threshold 也不意味着：

```
brave
decisive
```

它只是行动结构。

---

# 30. Impact Rule

Impact 应至少考虑：

```
magnitude
duration
number of affected domains
number of affected people
difficulty of repair
```

不是只看 immediate size。

---

# 31. Reversibility Rule

必须读取 NAV-06：

```
HIGHLY_REVERSIBLE
REVERSIBLE_WITH_COST
PARTIALLY_REVERSIBLE
LOW_REVERSIBILITY
EFFECTIVELY_IRREVERSIBLE
```

并加入：

```
residual effects
```

而不是只问：

> 能不能撤销？

---

# 32. Affected-Party Rule

如果行动主要影响用户本人：

```
threshold may remain individual
```

如果明显影响：

```
partner
children
dependants
employees
co-owner
```

则 threshold 还必须包含：

```
authority
consent
shared responsibility
```

---

# 33. Minimum-State Exposure Rule

建议状态：

```
FAR_ABOVE_MINIMUM
ABOVE_MINIMUM
NEAR_MINIMUM
POSSIBLE_BREACH
LIKELY_BREACH
UNKNOWN
```

越接近 minimum，所需准备越强。

---

# 34. Recovery Difficulty Rule

建议：

```
EASY_RECOVERY
MODERATE_RECOVERY
DIFFICULT_RECOVERY
RECOVERY_UNCERTAIN
RECOVERY_NOT_ESTABLISHED
```

但不能用简单 numerical score 合并。

---

# 35. Threshold and Small Experiment

如果：

```
full action = T4
```

而：

```
small pilot = T1/T2
```

Navigation 应允许：

```
SMALLER_ACTION_ADMISSION
```

从现实中学习。

这不是逃避大决定，而是：

```
reduce consequence while learning
```

---

# 36. Threshold and Delay

如果 Action 尚未达到 required threshold：

```
WAIT
```

也不一定是答案。

可以：

```
gather critical information
reduce scale
increase buffer
obtain consent
seek professional review
build exit route
```

---

# 37. Threshold and Urgency

可能出现：

```
Urgent
+
High Threshold
+
Incomplete Information
```

系统不能偷偷把 threshold 降低。

应考虑：

```
professional escalation
minimal reversible action
decline option
temporary safeguard
```

---

# 38. Threshold and Optionality

如果方案保留：

```
future options
exit routes
recovery capacity
```

即使影响不小，也可能更可承担。

但 optionality 不能补偿：

```
hard minimum violation
consent violation
legal requirement
```

---

# 39. Threshold and Interpretation

冻结：

> **Interpretive confidence does not reduce the threshold required by material impact and irreversibility.**

中文：

> **解释上的确信，不能降低现实影响与不可逆性所要求的决策门槛。**

---

# 40. Threshold and Professional Input

专业意见可以：

```
reduce domain uncertainty
clarify formal requirements
improve recovery design
```

但仍不自动选择人生方向。

---

# 41. Threshold Met Rule

只有当：

```
currentDecisionSufficiency
```

达到或超过：

```
requiredThreshold
```

并且：

```
authority requirements satisfied
hard minimum not violated
```

才可：

```
THRESHOLD_MET
```

---

# 42. Threshold Not Met Rule

如果：

```
THRESHOLD_NOT_MET
```

必须输出：

```
what is missing
why it matters
what smaller action may still qualify
```

不能只说：

> 信息不足。

---

# 43. Customer Projection Example

内部：

```
Action A:
Apply for consulting roles

Impact:
low

Reversibility:
high

Required threshold:
T1

Current sufficiency:
met

Action B:
Resign immediately

Impact:
high

Reversibility:
partial

Affected:
household

Minimum-state exposure:
near financial floor

Recovery:
available but uncertain

Required threshold:
T4

Current sufficiency:
not yet met
```

客户可以看到：

> **现在不是“这个方向能不能开始”的单一问题，而是不同动作需要不同程度的确定。**
> 
> 你已经知道得足够多，可以开始申请、测试客户需求、建立第二收入来源，这些步骤的成本有限，而且容易停止；但“立刻辞去唯一收入来源”是另一种等级的决定，它会直接影响家庭现金流，也会明显缩小恢复空间，因此需要更高程度的充分性。
> 
> 换句话说，目前不是“不能前进”，而是已经可以前进到较小、可逆的那一步，却还没有足够现实基础跨过最大的承诺。

---

# 44. Customer Actions

允许：

```
Proceed at current scale
Reduce action scale
Increase buffer
Resolve critical unknown
Request consent
Request professional review
Strengthen exit route
Wait with explicit reason
Reassess threshold
Continue
```

---

# 45. `status`

建议：

```
UNFORMED
PARTIAL
THRESHOLD_T1
THRESHOLD_T2
THRESHOLD_T3
THRESHOLD_T4
FORMAL_GATE_REQUIRED
THRESHOLD_MET
THRESHOLD_NOT_MET
REDUCED_ACTION_AVAILABLE
ESCALATION_REQUIRED
REOPENED
```

---

# 46. Fail-Closed Conditions

以下情况不得进入 NAV-28：

```
actionScaleUndefined
impactUnderstated
reversibilityMissing
affectedPartyIgnored
minimumStateExposureUnknownForHighImpactAction
recoveryRouteMissing
authorityRequirementIgnored
consentRequirementIgnored
symbolicReadingUsedToLowerThreshold
thresholdMetDeclaredFromConfidenceAlone
decisionObjectChanged
```

---

# 47. Canonical Runtime Rule

> **Navigation must match the required level of decision sufficiency to the impact, reversibility, responsibility, and recovery burden of the specific action being considered.**

中文：

> **Navigation 必须让所需决策充分程度，与正在考虑的具体行动之影响、可逆性、责任范围与恢复负担相匹配。**

---

# 48. Canonical Scale Rule

> **A decision may fail the threshold for a large action while passing the threshold for a smaller reversible action.**

中文：

> **一个决定可以尚未达到重大行动的门槛，却已经达到较小、可逆行动的门槛。**

---

# 49. Canonical Impact Rule

> **Higher consequence requires stronger grounding; urgency does not erase that requirement.**

中文：

> **后果越大，需要的现实基础越强；紧迫性不会自动取消这项要求。**

---

# 50. Canonical Reversibility Rule

> **Reversibility lowers the cost of being wrong; it does not make evidence, responsibility, or minimum-state protection irrelevant.**

中文：

> **可逆性降低的是判断错误以后付出的代价，却不会让证据、责任与最低状态保护变得不重要。**

---

# 51. Canonical Non-Scoring Rule

> **Impact and reversibility must shape the threshold without collapsing human decisions into a single weighted score.**

中文：

> **影响与可逆性必须真正改变决策门槛，却不能因此把人的决定压成一个加权总分。**

---

# 52. Canonical Authority Rule

> **Where law, consent, professional responsibility, or legitimate shared authority governs the action, higher confidence cannot substitute for the required authority.**

中文：

> **当法律、同意、专业责任或合法共同权威对行动具有正式约束时，再高的确信程度都不能取代真正需要的权威。**

---

# 53. Final Canonical Form

```
NAV-27
IMPACT / REVERSIBILITY THRESHOLD
```

**Input**

```
Decision Sufficiency State
+
Specific Action
+
Impact
+
Reversibility
+
Affected Parties
+
Minimum-State Exposure
+
Recovery Capacity
```

**Process**

```
Determine:
How big is the consequence?
How difficult is reversal?
Who else is affected?
How close is downside to the floor?
How recoverable is failure?
What authority is required?
What sufficiency level does this action require?
```

**Output**

```
Required Decision Threshold
+
Threshold-Met State
+
Allowed Action Scale
+
Remaining Requirements
```

**Boundary**

```
The threshold belongs to the action, not the person.
Smaller action may qualify before larger commitment.
Confidence cannot substitute for reality.
```

modules.canonicalQuestion:
当一个决定的后果会由多个人共同承担时，
为什么“我有意见”与“我有决定权”不能被当成同一件事？
modules.definition:
**Shared Authority** 是 Navigation 对“当一个决定同时影响多个合法主体时，谁拥有决定权、谁必须被纳入、谁需要同意、谁可以提供意见，以及谁不能替别人决定”进行正式分层的机制。

它不是：

```
everyone gets an equal vote
```

也不是：

```
the person who asked PHI OS decides everything
```

更不是：

```
who is affected most
=
who automatically has total authority
```

它真正回答的是：

> **这个决定究竟属于谁，哪些部分需要共同决定，哪些部分仍属于个人自主，以及什么条件必须经过合法同意以后才能进入行动？**

例如：

```
User wants:
move overseas for a new role
```

这个决定可能同时包含：

```
Personal career choice
Household relocation
Child schooling
Shared housing
Partner employment
Family financial structure
```

这里不能简单写成：

```
用户想搬
→ 用户决定搬
```

也不能反过来写成：

```
家庭受影响
→ 用户完全失去个人职业决定权
```

而应该拆成：

```
PERSONAL AUTHORITY
SHARED AUTHORITY
CONSENT-BOUND COMPONENT
RESPONSIBILITY-BOUND COMPONENT
```

因此：

> **NAV-28 的核心，是把一个看似单一的决定拆开，确认其中哪些部分属于个人，哪些部分属于共同现实，避免“共同影响”被误写成“单方决定”，也避免“需要共同决定”被扩大成“任何人都可以控制全部决定”。**

---
modules.navigationMeaning:
NAV-08 已经建立：

```
Navigation supports.
Humans decide.
```

并区分：

```
USER_DECISION_OWNER
SHARED_DECISION
CONSENT_REQUIRED
PROFESSIONAL_REQUIRED
```

NAV-28 在此基础上进一步处理一个更困难的问题：

> **当决定确实属于多个人时，决定权怎样在不同部分之间分布？**

现实中的 shared decision 很少是真正简单的：

```
50 / 50
```

例如：

```
夫妻是否搬家
```

可能同时涉及：

```
A 的职业选择
B 的职业选择
孩子的照护与学校
共同房产
共同财务
家庭支持网络
```

所以 NAV-28 建立：

```
Decision Object
↓
Affected Parties
↓
Authority by Component
↓
Consent Requirements
↓
Shared Constraints
↓
Jointly Actionable Decision Space
```

也就是说：

> **共同决定不是把所有人的人生压成一个共同按钮，而是确认哪些现实必须共同成立，行动才真正具有资格。**

---
modules.requiredInputs:
NAV-28 最低需要：

```
confirmedDecisionObject
decisionOwner
affectedParties
authorityMap
nonExchangeableConditions
minimumAcceptableState
candidateAction
```

并且至少需要知道：

```
who is directly affected
who carries consequence
who owns relevant asset / right / responsibility
who must consent
```

如果这些不清楚，应保持：

modules.allowedInference:
NAV-28 可以：

## A. 将一个大 Decision Object 拆成不同 authority components

例如：

```
Move overseas
```

可拆成：

```
User accepts overseas job
→ personal authority

Sell jointly owned house
→ shared authority

Move child
→ responsibility / guardian authority

Partner leaves own job
→ partner's personal authority
```

这是非常重要的 capability。

---

## B. 识别某一部分可以先独立推进

例如：

```
apply for overseas role
```

可能属于：

```
SOLE_AUTHORITY
```

即使：

```
final family relocation
```

仍需要 Shared Authority。

因此 shared decision 不必过早阻塞所有探索。

---

## C. 识别行动需要共同同意，但资料搜集不需要

例如：

```
research schools
compare housing
estimate costs
```

可以进行，

但：

```
sign lease
sell house
move child
```

可能需要额外 authority。

---

## D. 识别不同人的最低状态

例如：

```
User minimum:
career flexibility

Partner minimum:
income continuity

Child minimum:
care continuity
```

不能只用用户的 minimum state 代表全部。

---

## E. 识别 authority conflict

例如：

```
user wants change
partner does not consent
```

如果该行动属于 shared-authority component，应标记：

```
AUTHORITY_CONFLICT
```

而不是让系统替双方投票。

---
modules.forbiddenInference:
NAV-28 严禁：

## A. 把“受影响”自动等于“拥有否决权”

禁止：

```
affected
→ full authority
```

---

## B. 把“关系更亲近”自动等于“权力更大”

例如：

```
parent
partner
employer
```

都不能自动取得超出实际范围的 authority。

---

## C. 把用户的陈述当成第三方同意

禁止：

```
user says partner is okay
→ consent confirmed
```

除非产品与数据规则确实允许相应方式确认。

---

## D. 推断第三方隐藏意图

禁止：

```
your partner actually wants...
your child secretly prefers...
```

---

## E. 让多数意见自动压过合法个人权利

```
3 people agree
1 person owns the right
```

不能自动按票数决定。

---

## F. 让 AI 调解成最终裁决者

Navigation 可以整理冲突，

不能成为：

```
final arbiter
```

```
required shared authority
or
```

```
ACTION_ADMITTED
```

冻结：

```
+
AUTHORITY
=
```

NAV-28 可以：

- 拆 authority components；
- 明确谁决定什么；
- 明确谁必须同意；
- 识别 consultation；
- 识别 representation；
- 识别 conflict；
- 允许不需要共同授权的探索先进行。

NAV-28 不可以：

- 替第三方同意；
- 替关系双方裁决；
- 赋予自己 formal authority；
- 把多数票变成普遍规则；
- 因为用户付费就偏向用户；
- 把“建议”升级为共同决定。

modules.humanDecisionBoundary:
Shared Authority 并不取消个人 agency。

例如：

```
User:
I want to leave this job.
```

系统不能说：

> 你伴侣不同意，所以你不能离职。

因为：

```
employment choice
```

可能主要属于用户。

但可以指出：

> 如果离职会改变共同家庭收入、照护安排或住房计划，这些共同后果需要被共同处理。

因此必须冻结：

> **A person may retain authority over their own action while still carrying responsibility for shared consequences.**

中文：

> **一个人可以保有对自己行动的决定权，同时仍然必须对这个行动产生的共同后果承担现实责任。**

canonicalSections.heading: `canonicalTitleZh`
canonicalSections.body:
```
共同决定权
```

canonicalSections.heading: `canonicalTitleEn`
canonicalSections.body:
```
Shared Authority
```

canonicalSections.heading: `canonicalQuestion`
canonicalSections.body:
```
当一个决定的后果会由多个人共同承担时，
为什么“我有意见”与“我有决定权”不能被当成同一件事？
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: `definition`
canonicalSections.body:
**Shared Authority** 是 Navigation 对“当一个决定同时影响多个合法主体时，谁拥有决定权、谁必须被纳入、谁需要同意、谁可以提供意见，以及谁不能替别人决定”进行正式分层的机制。

它不是：

```
everyone gets an equal vote
```

也不是：

```
the person who asked PHI OS decides everything
```

更不是：

```
who is affected most
=
who automatically has total authority
```

它真正回答的是：

> **这个决定究竟属于谁，哪些部分需要共同决定，哪些部分仍属于个人自主，以及什么条件必须经过合法同意以后才能进入行动？**

例如：

```
User wants:
move overseas for a new role
```

这个决定可能同时包含：

```
Personal career choice
Household relocation
Child schooling
Shared housing
Partner employment
Family financial structure
```

这里不能简单写成：

```
用户想搬
→ 用户决定搬
```

也不能反过来写成：

```
家庭受影响
→ 用户完全失去个人职业决定权
```

而应该拆成：

```
PERSONAL AUTHORITY
SHARED AUTHORITY
CONSENT-BOUND COMPONENT
RESPONSIBILITY-BOUND COMPONENT
```

因此：

> **NAV-28 的核心，是把一个看似单一的决定拆开，确认其中哪些部分属于个人，哪些部分属于共同现实，避免“共同影响”被误写成“单方决定”，也避免“需要共同决定”被扩大成“任何人都可以控制全部决定”。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: `navigationMeaning`
canonicalSections.body:
NAV-08 已经建立：

```
Navigation supports.
Humans decide.
```

并区分：

```
USER_DECISION_OWNER
SHARED_DECISION
CONSENT_REQUIRED
PROFESSIONAL_REQUIRED
```

NAV-28 在此基础上进一步处理一个更困难的问题：

> **当决定确实属于多个人时，决定权怎样在不同部分之间分布？**

现实中的 shared decision 很少是真正简单的：

```
50 / 50
```

例如：

```
夫妻是否搬家
```

可能同时涉及：

```
A 的职业选择
B 的职业选择
孩子的照护与学校
共同房产
共同财务
家庭支持网络
```

所以 NAV-28 建立：

```
Decision Object
↓
Affected Parties
↓
Authority by Component
↓
Consent Requirements
↓
Shared Constraints
↓
Jointly Actionable Decision Space
```

也就是说：

> **共同决定不是把所有人的人生压成一个共同按钮，而是确认哪些现实必须共同成立，行动才真正具有资格。**

canonicalSections.heading: Core Shared-Authority Classes
canonicalSections.body:
建议至少区分：

```
SOLE_AUTHORITY
SHARED_AUTHORITY
CONSENT_REQUIRED
CONSULTATION_REQUIRED
AFFECTED_BUT_NOT_DECISION_OWNER
REPRESENTATIVE_AUTHORITY
PROFESSIONAL_AUTHORITY
INSTITUTIONAL_AUTHORITY
AUTHORITY_UNRESOLVED
```

---

## A. `SOLE_AUTHORITY`

该决定部分主要属于一个人本人。

例如：

```
是否申请某职位
是否学习某项技能
是否表达自己的边界
```

只要不越过其他人的权利。

---

## B. `SHARED_AUTHORITY`

行动本身需要多个合法主体共同成立。

例如：

```
出售共同产权房产
家庭整体搬迁
共同承担重大债务
共同商业资产处理
```

---

## C. `CONSENT_REQUIRED`

某行动不能只靠 consultation。

必须有真实同意。

例如：

```
sharing another person's private data
changing jointly owned asset
certain relationship arrangements
specific medical / legal contexts
```

---

## D. `CONSULTATION_REQUIRED`

决定权可能仍主要属于一人，但因为后果明显影响他人，必须把他人的现实纳入。

例如：

```
用户个人换工作
```

决定权主要属于用户，

但如果会改变：

```
family income
childcare
household schedule
```

则 consultation 具有现实意义。

---

## E. `AFFECTED_BUT_NOT_DECISION_OWNER`

一个人可能受到影响，却不因此自动取得完整决定权。

例如：

```
colleague affected by user's resignation
```

并不自动拥有否决权。

---

## F. `REPRESENTATIVE_AUTHORITY`

某些情况下决定由合法代表承担。

例如：

```
minor
dependent
incapacitated person
```

但代表者必须：

```
represent legitimate interests
```

而不是：

```
invent hidden preferences
```

---

canonicalSections.body:
Profile 可以帮助理解：

```
communication preference
decision style
relationship friction
coordination tendency
```

但不得建立：

```
consent
formal authority
third-party preference
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: `financialConsumer`
canonicalSections.body:
Financial 对 shared authority 尤其重要。

例如：

```
joint debt
joint property
shared household obligations
dependants
beneficiaries
```

必须区分：

```
personal financial decision
```

与：

```
shared financial consequence
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: `methodConsumer`
canonicalSections.body:
AST / BAZI / ZIWEI / NUM / HD / ECR / Tarot / I Ching：

只能帮助提出：

```
relationship or responsibility question
```

不得：

```
infer consent
infer partner intention
assign decision authority
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: `currentRealityConsumer`
canonicalSections.body:
Current Reality 至少应提供：

```
whoIsAffected
whoCarriesCost
whoOwnsRelevantAsset
whoHasRelevantResponsibility
whatConsentExists
whatConsentIsMissing
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: `runtimeConsumer`
canonicalSections.body:
NAV-28 可被：

```
My Reality Navigation
Relationship Navigation
Career Navigation
Financial Navigation
Estate Navigation
Family Navigation
Structural Transition Planning
Professional Handoff
Action Runtime
```

消费。

---

canonicalSections.heading: `academyConsumer`
canonicalSections.body:
Academy 可投影为：

> **Being affected by a decision does not automatically give someone control over the whole decision; but owning a personal choice does not erase responsibility for shared consequences.**

中文：

> **受到一个决定影响，并不会自动让一个人取得整个决定的控制权；但拥有个人选择，也不会因此取消对共同后果的责任。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: `revisionTriggers`
canonicalSections.body:
以下情况必须重开 NAV-28：

```
affectedPartyChanged
ownershipChanged
consentChanged
relationshipStatusChanged
dependantChanged
guardianStatusChanged
decisionComponentChanged
financialResponsibilityChanged
legalAuthorityChanged
professionalRequirementChanged
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Canonical Shared Authority Model
canonicalSections.body:
建议：

```
{
  "sharedAuthorityAssessmentId": "",
  "decisionObjectId": "",
  "components": [
    {
      "componentId": "",
      "description": "",
      "authorityState": "SOLE_AUTHORITY | SHARED_AUTHORITY | CONSENT_REQUIRED | CONSULTATION_REQUIRED | AFFECTED_BUT_NOT_DECISION_OWNER | REPRESENTATIVE_AUTHORITY | PROFESSIONAL_AUTHORITY | INSTITUTIONAL_AUTHORITY | AUTHORITY_UNRESOLVED",
      "decisionOwners": [],
      "affectedParties": [],
      "consentRequiredFrom": [],
      "consultationRequiredWith": [],
      "authoritySources": [],
      "status": ""
    }
  ],
  "authorityConflicts": [],
  "unresolvedConsent": [],
  "actionEffects": [],
  "status": ""
}
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Decision-Component Rule
canonicalSections.body:
冻结：

> **Shared authority should be assigned to decision components, not automatically to the entire life decision.**

中文：

> **共同决定权应当落实到具体决策组成部分，而不能因为某一部分需要共同决定，就把整个人生决定全部变成共同所有。**

这是 NAV-28 最重要的规则之一。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Affected ≠ Owner Rule
canonicalSections.body:
冻结：

```
AFFECTED
≠
DECISION OWNER
```

一个人受到后果影响，需要被考虑；

但是否拥有：

```
consultation
consent
shared authority
```

必须另外判断。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Consultation ≠ Consent Rule
canonicalSections.body:
必须区分：

```
CONSULTATION
```

与：

```
CONSENT
```

例如：

```
informing partner
discussing with partner
partner consenting
```

是三个不同状态。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Consent Rule
canonicalSections.body:
Consent 应尽量满足：

```
specific
informed
scope-bound
current
```

不能把：

```
过去同意过类似事情
```

自动延伸成：

```
现在同意这一次
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Personal Agency Rule
canonicalSections.body:
Shared Authority 不能被用来合法化：

```
control of another adult's entire life
```

例如：

```
partner affected by job choice
```

不意味着：

```
partner owns user's career
```

必须拆解共同影响。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Shared Consequence Rule
canonicalSections.body:
反过来：

```
“这是我的选择”
```

也不能被用来忽略：

```
joint debt
childcare
shared housing
dependant support
```

等真实共同后果。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Ownership Rule
canonicalSections.body:
共同资产：

```
joint property
shared business
joint account
```

必须读取真实 ownership / authority。

不能由关系身份猜测。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Responsibility Rule
canonicalSections.body:
照护责任可能产生：

```
RESPONSIBILITY_BOUND_AUTHORITY
```

例如涉及孩子的决定，不能只按：

```
who wants it more
```

来处理。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Representative Authority Rule
canonicalSections.body:
合法代表在为他人决定时：

```
representative authority
```

不等于：

```
personal preference authority
```

Navigation 必须尽量围绕：

```
represented person's welfare
legal scope
known preference where available
```

处理。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Authority Conflict Rule
canonicalSections.body:
如果出现：

```
AUTHORITY_CONFLICT
```

例如：

```
co-owners disagree
```

系统不能生成：

```
majority recommendation
```

来代替真实解决机制。

应输出：

```
UNRESOLVED_SHARED_AUTHORITY
```

并可能进入：

```
professional
legal
mediation
shared discussion
```

路径。

---

canonicalSections.heading: No Proxy Consent Rule
canonicalSections.body:
冻结：

> **One person's account, interpretation, or report cannot silently provide consent on behalf of another person.**

中文：

> **一个人的账户、叙述、报告或解读，不能悄悄替另一个人提供同意。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: Exploration Before Consent Rule
canonicalSections.body:
某些情况下，可以在 consent 完成前继续：

```
research
scenario comparison
cost estimation
question clarification
```

但不能进入：

```
binding action
data use beyond scope
formal commitment
```

这使系统不必因为 shared decision 尚未完成就完全停止所有 Navigation。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Separate-Path Rule
canonicalSections.body:
如果双方不能达成共同决定，Navigation 应检查：

```
which parts can remain separate?
```

例如：

```
User may apply for role
Partner may independently evaluate own career
Family move decision remains unresolved
```

而不是把所有东西都绑定成一个 Yes / No。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Shared Minimum State Rule
canonicalSections.body:
当多人共同承担后果时，不能只使用一个人的：

```
Minimum Acceptable State
```

需要至少检查：

```
shared material minimum
responsibility minimum
affected-party minimum
```

但不能凭空推断他人 preference。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Shared Value Conflict Rule
canonicalSections.body:
例如：

```
User values:
career growth

Partner values:
location stability
```

Navigation 可以显示冲突，

但不能：

```
rank person A's value against person B's value
```

然后得出总分。

应交给：

```
shared decision process
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Shared Authority and Threshold
canonicalSections.body:
高影响 shared decision 需要同时满足：

```
Decision Sufficiency
+
Impact / Reversibility Threshold
+
Authority Completeness
```

缺一不可。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Shared Authority and Action Scale
canonicalSections.body:
如果共同 authority 尚未完整，

有时仍可以：

```
reduce action scale
```

进入个人权限内的下一步。

例如：

```
apply
research
interview
visit
estimate
```

而不进入：

```
sign
sell
move
terminate
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Shared Authority and Professional Input
canonicalSections.body:
专业人士可以：

```
clarify rights
clarify obligations
clarify consequences
```

但：

```
professional opinion
```

不一定解决：

```
relationship value conflict
```

必须保持范围。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Customer Projection Example
canonicalSections.body:
内部：

```
Decision:
Move overseas for new role

Components:

Accept job offer
→ USER SOLE AUTHORITY

Sell jointly owned home
→ SHARED AUTHORITY

Relocate child
→ SHARED / RESPONSIBILITY-BOUND

Partner leaves own job
→ PARTNER SOLE AUTHORITY

Use partner's private financial data
→ CONSENT REQUIRED
```

客户可以看到：

> **这个决定并不是一个单一的“我们搬不搬”。**
> 
> 接受一份工作首先属于你的职业选择，你可以决定自己是否申请、面试，甚至在一定阶段接受条件谈判；但真正让全家搬迁，会同时进入共同住房、孩子照护与教育、伴侣自己的职业，以及家庭财务结构，因此这些部分不能由任何一个人单方面代表全部人完成。
> 
> 这也意味着，目前即使家庭还没有达成搬迁共识，你仍然可以继续做属于你个人权限范围内的探索，例如完成面试、确认薪资、了解地点与学校；真正需要共同决定的是那些会把共同现实正式改变的部分。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Customer Actions
canonicalSections.body:
允许：

```
Confirm decision owner
Split decision components
Add affected party
Mark consultation required
Request consent
Resolve ownership
Proceed with personal-authority step
Pause shared action
Request professional review
Continue
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: `status`
canonicalSections.body:
建议：

```
UNFORMED
PARTIAL
SOLE_AUTHORITY_CLEAR
SHARED_AUTHORITY_CLEAR
CONSENT_REQUIRED
CONSULTATION_REQUIRED
AUTHORITY_CONFLICT
AUTHORITY_UNRESOLVED
READY_FOR_ACTION_RUNTIME
REOPENED
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Fail-Closed Conditions
canonicalSections.body:
以下情况不得进入 NAV-29：

```
decisionOwnerUnknown
sharedDecisionComponentNotSeparated
requiredConsentMissing
ownershipAssumed
thirdPartyPreferenceInvented
representativeAuthorityUnverified
affectedPartyIgnored
sharedMinimumIgnored
professionalAuthorityRequirementIgnored
symbolicReadingUsedAsAuthorityEvidence
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Canonical Runtime Rule
canonicalSections.body:
> **Navigation must assign authority to the specific components of a shared decision rather than assume that one person either owns everything or owns nothing.**

中文：

> **Navigation 必须把决定权落实到共同决定中的具体组成部分，而不能假设一个人要么拥有全部决定权，要么完全没有决定权。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: Canonical Affected-Party Rule
canonicalSections.body:
> **Being affected creates relevance; it does not automatically create total decision authority.**

中文：

> **受到影响，会产生被纳入决定的现实相关性，却不会自动产生对整个决定的完全控制权。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: Canonical Agency Rule
canonicalSections.body:
> **Personal autonomy and shared responsibility can both be true at the same time.**

中文：

> **个人自主与共同责任可以同时成立，并不需要其中一方消灭另一方。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: Canonical Consent Rule
canonicalSections.body:
> **Consultation is not consent, and one person's account cannot provide consent for another.**

中文：

> **协商不是同意，一个人的叙述也不能替另一个人提供同意。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: Canonical Shared-Action Rule
canonicalSections.body:
> **When a shared action requires multiple legitimate authorities, decision sufficiency alone is not enough; the authority conditions must also be complete.**

中文：

> **当一个共同动作需要多个合法决定主体共同成立时，仅仅达到决策充分仍然不够，相关权威与同意条件也必须完整。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: Canonical No-Arbitration Rule
canonicalSections.body:
> **Navigation may clarify conflict, map rights and responsibilities, and structure the decision; it must not silently become the final arbiter between legitimate decision-makers.**

中文：

> **Navigation 可以澄清冲突、整理权利与责任并组织共同决定，却不能悄悄成为合法决定主体之间的最终裁判者。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: Final Canonical Form
canonicalSections.body:
```
NAV-28
SHARED AUTHORITY
```

**Input**

```
Decision Object
+
Specific Action
+
Decision Owners
+
Affected Parties
+
Ownership / Responsibility / Consent
```

**Process**

```
Split:
What belongs to one person?
What belongs to multiple people?
Who must be consulted?
Who must consent?
Who has formal authority?
Which parts may proceed independently?
```

**Output**

```
Shared Authority Map
+
Consent / Consultation State
+
Action Permission Boundary
```

**Boundary**

```
Affected does not equal owner.
Personal authority does not erase shared consequences.
Consultation does not equal consent.
Navigation does not arbitrate human lives.
```

modules.canonicalText:
# NAV-28｜Shared Authority

## 共同决定权｜当一个决定不只属于一个人，谁有权一起决定

**Canonical Question｜规范问题**

> **当一个决定的后果会由多个人共同承担时，为什么“我有意见”与“我有决定权”不能被当成同一件事？**

---

## 1. `moduleId`

```
NAV-28
```

## 2. `canonicalTitleZh`

```
共同决定权
```

## 3. `canonicalTitleEn`

```
Shared Authority
```

## 4. `canonicalQuestion`

```
当一个决定的后果会由多个人共同承担时，
为什么“我有意见”与“我有决定权”不能被当成同一件事？
```

---

# 5. `definition`

**Shared Authority** 是 Navigation 对“当一个决定同时影响多个合法主体时，谁拥有决定权、谁必须被纳入、谁需要同意、谁可以提供意见，以及谁不能替别人决定”进行正式分层的机制。

它不是：

```
everyone gets an equal vote
```

也不是：

```
the person who asked PHI OS decides everything
```

更不是：

```
who is affected most
=
who automatically has total authority
```

它真正回答的是：

> **这个决定究竟属于谁，哪些部分需要共同决定，哪些部分仍属于个人自主，以及什么条件必须经过合法同意以后才能进入行动？**

例如：

```
User wants:
move overseas for a new role
```

这个决定可能同时包含：

```
Personal career choice
Household relocation
Child schooling
Shared housing
Partner employment
Family financial structure
```

这里不能简单写成：

```
用户想搬
→ 用户决定搬
```

也不能反过来写成：

```
家庭受影响
→ 用户完全失去个人职业决定权
```

而应该拆成：

```
PERSONAL AUTHORITY
SHARED AUTHORITY
CONSENT-BOUND COMPONENT
RESPONSIBILITY-BOUND COMPONENT
```

因此：

> **NAV-28 的核心，是把一个看似单一的决定拆开，确认其中哪些部分属于个人，哪些部分属于共同现实，避免“共同影响”被误写成“单方决定”，也避免“需要共同决定”被扩大成“任何人都可以控制全部决定”。**

---

# 6. `navigationMeaning`

NAV-08 已经建立：

```
Navigation supports.
Humans decide.
```

并区分：

```
USER_DECISION_OWNER
SHARED_DECISION
CONSENT_REQUIRED
PROFESSIONAL_REQUIRED
```

NAV-28 在此基础上进一步处理一个更困难的问题：

> **当决定确实属于多个人时，决定权怎样在不同部分之间分布？**

现实中的 shared decision 很少是真正简单的：

```
50 / 50
```

例如：

```
夫妻是否搬家
```

可能同时涉及：

```
A 的职业选择
B 的职业选择
孩子的照护与学校
共同房产
共同财务
家庭支持网络
```

所以 NAV-28 建立：

```
Decision Object
↓
Affected Parties
↓
Authority by Component
↓
Consent Requirements
↓
Shared Constraints
↓
Jointly Actionable Decision Space
```

也就是说：

> **共同决定不是把所有人的人生压成一个共同按钮，而是确认哪些现实必须共同成立，行动才真正具有资格。**

---

# 7. `requiredInputs`

NAV-28 最低需要：

```
confirmedDecisionObject
decisionOwner
affectedParties
authorityMap
nonExchangeableConditions
minimumAcceptableState
candidateAction
```

并且至少需要知道：

```
who is directly affected
who carries consequence
who owns relevant asset / right / responsibility
who must consent
```

如果这些不清楚，应保持：

```
SHARED_AUTHORITY_UNRESOLVED
```

---

# 8. `optionalInputs`

```
relationshipContext
financialNavigationProjection
currentRealityProjection
legalOrContractualContext
careContext
estateContext
organizationalContext
professionalInput
guardianContext
priorNavigationState
```

这些用于判断：

- 谁拥有正式 authority；
- 哪些是法律要求；
- 哪些属于个人自主；
- 哪些是真正共同承担的后果。

---

# 9. `inputAuthorityClasses`

允许：

```
VERIFIED_IDENTITY
VERIFIED_ROLE
OWNERSHIP_RECORD
CONSENT_RECORD
LEGAL_OR_CONTRACTUAL_RECORD
RESPONSIBILITY_RECORD
USER_REPORTED_RELATIONSHIP
PROFESSIONAL_INPUT
CURRENT_REALITY
INTERPRETIVE_CONTEXT
UNKNOWN
```

其中：

```
FORMAL_SHARED_AUTHORITY
```

不能由：

```
Profile
BaZi
Zi Wei
Tarot
I Ching
Astrology
```

建立。

---

# 10. Core Shared-Authority Classes

建议至少区分：

```
SOLE_AUTHORITY
SHARED_AUTHORITY
CONSENT_REQUIRED
CONSULTATION_REQUIRED
AFFECTED_BUT_NOT_DECISION_OWNER
REPRESENTATIVE_AUTHORITY
PROFESSIONAL_AUTHORITY
INSTITUTIONAL_AUTHORITY
AUTHORITY_UNRESOLVED
```

---

## A. `SOLE_AUTHORITY`

该决定部分主要属于一个人本人。

例如：

```
是否申请某职位
是否学习某项技能
是否表达自己的边界
```

只要不越过其他人的权利。

---

## B. `SHARED_AUTHORITY`

行动本身需要多个合法主体共同成立。

例如：

```
出售共同产权房产
家庭整体搬迁
共同承担重大债务
共同商业资产处理
```

---

## C. `CONSENT_REQUIRED`

某行动不能只靠 consultation。

必须有真实同意。

例如：

```
sharing another person's private data
changing jointly owned asset
certain relationship arrangements
specific medical / legal contexts
```

---

## D. `CONSULTATION_REQUIRED`

决定权可能仍主要属于一人，但因为后果明显影响他人，必须把他人的现实纳入。

例如：

```
用户个人换工作
```

决定权主要属于用户，

但如果会改变：

```
family income
childcare
household schedule
```

则 consultation 具有现实意义。

---

## E. `AFFECTED_BUT_NOT_DECISION_OWNER`

一个人可能受到影响，却不因此自动取得完整决定权。

例如：

```
colleague affected by user's resignation
```

并不自动拥有否决权。

---

## F. `REPRESENTATIVE_AUTHORITY`

某些情况下决定由合法代表承担。

例如：

```
minor
dependent
incapacitated person
```

但代表者必须：

```
represent legitimate interests
```

而不是：

```
invent hidden preferences
```

---

# 11. `allowedInference`

NAV-28 可以：

## A. 将一个大 Decision Object 拆成不同 authority components

例如：

```
Move overseas
```

可拆成：

```
User accepts overseas job
→ personal authority

Sell jointly owned house
→ shared authority

Move child
→ responsibility / guardian authority

Partner leaves own job
→ partner's personal authority
```

这是非常重要的 capability。

---

## B. 识别某一部分可以先独立推进

例如：

```
apply for overseas role
```

可能属于：

```
SOLE_AUTHORITY
```

即使：

```
final family relocation
```

仍需要 Shared Authority。

因此 shared decision 不必过早阻塞所有探索。

---

## C. 识别行动需要共同同意，但资料搜集不需要

例如：

```
research schools
compare housing
estimate costs
```

可以进行，

但：

```
sign lease
sell house
move child
```

可能需要额外 authority。

---

## D. 识别不同人的最低状态

例如：

```
User minimum:
career flexibility

Partner minimum:
income continuity

Child minimum:
care continuity
```

不能只用用户的 minimum state 代表全部。

---

## E. 识别 authority conflict

例如：

```
user wants change
partner does not consent
```

如果该行动属于 shared-authority component，应标记：

```
AUTHORITY_CONFLICT
```

而不是让系统替双方投票。

---

# 12. `forbiddenInference`

NAV-28 严禁：

## A. 把“受影响”自动等于“拥有否决权”

禁止：

```
affected
→ full authority
```

---

## B. 把“关系更亲近”自动等于“权力更大”

例如：

```
parent
partner
employer
```

都不能自动取得超出实际范围的 authority。

---

## C. 把用户的陈述当成第三方同意

禁止：

```
user says partner is okay
→ consent confirmed
```

除非产品与数据规则确实允许相应方式确认。

---

## D. 推断第三方隐藏意图

禁止：

```
your partner actually wants...
your child secretly prefers...
```

---

## E. 让多数意见自动压过合法个人权利

```
3 people agree
1 person owns the right
```

不能自动按票数决定。

---

## F. 让 AI 调解成最终裁决者

Navigation 可以整理冲突，

不能成为：

```
final arbiter
```

---

# 13. `decisionEffect`

NAV-28 主要影响：

```
ACTION_PERMISSION
CONSENT_REQUIREMENT
SHARED_DECISION_SCOPE
OPTION_ELIGIBILITY
ACTION_SEQUENCE
ESCALATION_REQUIREMENT
```

核心 effect：

```
AUTHORITY_COMPLETENESS
```

即：

> **一个行动需要哪些人的合法权威真正到位，才可以进入现实。**

---

# 14. `decisionThresholdEffect`

即使 NAV-27 已判断：

```
threshold met
```

只要：

```
required shared authority
or
required consent
```

尚未完成，

就不能自动：

```
ACTION_ADMITTED
```

冻结：

```
SUFFICIENCY
+
AUTHORITY
=
ACTION READINESS
```

而不是：

```
SUFFICIENCY
=
AUTHORITY
```

---

# 15. `authorityBoundary`

NAV-28 可以：

- 拆 authority components；
- 明确谁决定什么；
- 明确谁必须同意；
- 识别 consultation；
- 识别 representation；
- 识别 conflict；
- 允许不需要共同授权的探索先进行。

NAV-28 不可以：

- 替第三方同意；
- 替关系双方裁决；
- 赋予自己 formal authority；
- 把多数票变成普遍规则；
- 因为用户付费就偏向用户；
- 把“建议”升级为共同决定。

---

# 16. `humanDecisionBoundary`

Shared Authority 并不取消个人 agency。

例如：

```
User:
I want to leave this job.
```

系统不能说：

> 你伴侣不同意，所以你不能离职。

因为：

```
employment choice
```

可能主要属于用户。

但可以指出：

> 如果离职会改变共同家庭收入、照护安排或住房计划，这些共同后果需要被共同处理。

因此必须冻结：

> **A person may retain authority over their own action while still carrying responsibility for shared consequences.**

中文：

> **一个人可以保有对自己行动的决定权，同时仍然必须对这个行动产生的共同后果承担现实责任。**

---

# 17. `sourceSections`

主要来源：

```
Book VIII
15.61–15.70｜Shared Authority
```

尤其：

```

15.62｜受到影响，不等于拥有全部决定权

15.64｜谁必须被纳入
15.65｜意见、协商与同意不是同一件事

15.69｜共同决定发生冲突怎么办
15.70｜Navigation 为什么不能成为最终裁决者
```

同时直接消费：

```

NAV-22 Minimum Acceptable State

```

# 18. `relatedBookFoundations`

## Book II｜Reality Runtime

提供：

```
agency

responsibility

```

NAV-28 不重新解释共同运行如何形成。

---

提供：

用于理解谁真正承担结果。

---

## Book VII｜Reality Observation

提供：

```

```

尤其支持：

> **不能因为知道一个人的资料，就取得替这个人同意的权力。**

---

# 19. `profileConsumer`

Profile 可以帮助理解：

```
communication preference
decision style
relationship friction
coordination tendency
```

但不得建立：

```
consent
formal authority
third-party preference
```

---

# 20. `financialConsumer`

Financial 对 shared authority 尤其重要。

例如：

```
joint debt
joint property
shared household obligations
dependants
beneficiaries
```

必须区分：

```
personal financial decision
```

与：

```
shared financial consequence
```

---

# 21. `methodConsumer`

AST / BAZI / ZIWEI / NUM / HD / ECR / Tarot / I Ching：

只能帮助提出：

```
relationship or responsibility question
```

不得：

```
infer consent
infer partner intention
assign decision authority
```

---

# 22. `currentRealityConsumer`

Current Reality 至少应提供：

```
whoIsAffected
whoCarriesCost
whoOwnsRelevantAsset
whoHasRelevantResponsibility
whatConsentExists
whatConsentIsMissing
```

---

# 23. `runtimeConsumer`

NAV-28 可被：

```
My Reality Navigation
Relationship Navigation
Career Navigation
Financial Navigation
Estate Navigation
Family Navigation
Structural Transition Planning
Professional Handoff
Action Runtime
```

消费。

---

# 24. `academyConsumer`

Academy 可投影为：

> **Being affected by a decision does not automatically give someone control over the whole decision; but owning a personal choice does not erase responsibility for shared consequences.**

中文：

> **受到一个决定影响，并不会自动让一个人取得整个决定的控制权；但拥有个人选择，也不会因此取消对共同后果的责任。**

---

# 25. `revisionTriggers`

以下情况必须重开 NAV-28：

```
affectedPartyChanged
ownershipChanged
consentChanged
relationshipStatusChanged
dependantChanged
guardianStatusChanged
decisionComponentChanged
financialResponsibilityChanged
legalAuthorityChanged
professionalRequirementChanged
```

---

# 26. Canonical Shared Authority Model

建议：

```
{
  "sharedAuthorityAssessmentId": "",
  "decisionObjectId": "",
  "components": [
    {
      "componentId": "",
      "description": "",
      "authorityState": "SOLE_AUTHORITY | SHARED_AUTHORITY | CONSENT_REQUIRED | CONSULTATION_REQUIRED | AFFECTED_BUT_NOT_DECISION_OWNER | REPRESENTATIVE_AUTHORITY | PROFESSIONAL_AUTHORITY | INSTITUTIONAL_AUTHORITY | AUTHORITY_UNRESOLVED",
      "decisionOwners": [],
      "affectedParties": [],
      "consentRequiredFrom": [],
      "consultationRequiredWith": [],
      "authoritySources": [],
      "status": ""
    }
  ],
  "authorityConflicts": [],
  "unresolvedConsent": [],
  "actionEffects": [],
  "status": ""
}
```

---

# 27. Decision-Component Rule

冻结：

> **Shared authority should be assigned to decision components, not automatically to the entire life decision.**

中文：

> **共同决定权应当落实到具体决策组成部分，而不能因为某一部分需要共同决定，就把整个人生决定全部变成共同所有。**

这是 NAV-28 最重要的规则之一。

---

# 28. Affected ≠ Owner Rule

冻结：

```
AFFECTED
≠
DECISION OWNER
```

一个人受到后果影响，需要被考虑；

但是否拥有：

```
consultation
consent
shared authority
```

必须另外判断。

---

# 29. Consultation ≠ Consent Rule

必须区分：

```
CONSULTATION
```

与：

```
CONSENT
```

例如：

```
informing partner
discussing with partner
partner consenting
```

是三个不同状态。

---

# 30. Consent Rule

Consent 应尽量满足：

```
specific
informed
scope-bound
current
```

不能把：

```
过去同意过类似事情
```

自动延伸成：

```
现在同意这一次
```

---

# 31. Personal Agency Rule

Shared Authority 不能被用来合法化：

```
control of another adult's entire life
```

例如：

```
partner affected by job choice
```

不意味着：

```
partner owns user's career
```

必须拆解共同影响。

---

# 32. Shared Consequence Rule

反过来：

```
“这是我的选择”
```

也不能被用来忽略：

```
joint debt
childcare
shared housing
dependant support
```

等真实共同后果。

---

# 33. Ownership Rule

共同资产：

```
joint property
shared business
joint account
```

必须读取真实 ownership / authority。

不能由关系身份猜测。

---

# 34. Responsibility Rule

照护责任可能产生：

```
RESPONSIBILITY_BOUND_AUTHORITY
```

例如涉及孩子的决定，不能只按：

```
who wants it more
```

来处理。

---

# 35. Representative Authority Rule

合法代表在为他人决定时：

```
representative authority
```

不等于：

```
personal preference authority
```

Navigation 必须尽量围绕：

```
represented person's welfare
legal scope
known preference where available
```

处理。

---

# 36. Authority Conflict Rule

如果出现：

```
AUTHORITY_CONFLICT
```

例如：

```
co-owners disagree
```

系统不能生成：

```
majority recommendation
```

来代替真实解决机制。

应输出：

```
UNRESOLVED_SHARED_AUTHORITY
```

并可能进入：

```
professional
legal
mediation
shared discussion
```

路径。

---

# 37. No Proxy Consent Rule

冻结：

> **One person's account, interpretation, or report cannot silently provide consent on behalf of another person.**

中文：

> **一个人的账户、叙述、报告或解读，不能悄悄替另一个人提供同意。**

---

# 38. Exploration Before Consent Rule

某些情况下，可以在 consent 完成前继续：

```
research
scenario comparison
cost estimation
question clarification
```

但不能进入：

```
binding action
data use beyond scope
formal commitment
```

这使系统不必因为 shared decision 尚未完成就完全停止所有 Navigation。

---

# 39. Separate-Path Rule

如果双方不能达成共同决定，Navigation 应检查：

```
which parts can remain separate?
```

例如：

```
User may apply for role
Partner may independently evaluate own career
Family move decision remains unresolved
```

而不是把所有东西都绑定成一个 Yes / No。

---

# 40. Shared Minimum State Rule

当多人共同承担后果时，不能只使用一个人的：

```
Minimum Acceptable State
```

需要至少检查：

```
shared material minimum
responsibility minimum
affected-party minimum
```

但不能凭空推断他人 preference。

---

# 41. Shared Value Conflict Rule

例如：

```
User values:
career growth

Partner values:
location stability
```

Navigation 可以显示冲突，

但不能：

```
rank person A's value against person B's value
```

然后得出总分。

应交给：

```
shared decision process
```

---

# 42. Shared Authority and Threshold

高影响 shared decision 需要同时满足：

```
Decision Sufficiency
+
Impact / Reversibility Threshold
+
Authority Completeness
```

缺一不可。

---

# 43. Shared Authority and Action Scale

如果共同 authority 尚未完整，

有时仍可以：

```
reduce action scale
```

进入个人权限内的下一步。

例如：

```
apply
research
interview
visit
estimate
```

而不进入：

```
sign
sell
move
terminate
```

---

# 44. Shared Authority and Professional Input

专业人士可以：

```
clarify rights
clarify obligations
clarify consequences
```

但：

```
professional opinion
```

不一定解决：

```
relationship value conflict
```

必须保持范围。

---

# 45. Customer Projection Example

内部：

```
Decision:
Move overseas for new role

Components:

Accept job offer
→ USER SOLE AUTHORITY

Sell jointly owned home
→ SHARED AUTHORITY

Relocate child
→ SHARED / RESPONSIBILITY-BOUND

Partner leaves own job
→ PARTNER SOLE AUTHORITY

Use partner's private financial data
→ CONSENT REQUIRED
```

客户可以看到：

> **这个决定并不是一个单一的“我们搬不搬”。**
> 
> 接受一份工作首先属于你的职业选择，你可以决定自己是否申请、面试，甚至在一定阶段接受条件谈判；但真正让全家搬迁，会同时进入共同住房、孩子照护与教育、伴侣自己的职业，以及家庭财务结构，因此这些部分不能由任何一个人单方面代表全部人完成。
> 
> 这也意味着，目前即使家庭还没有达成搬迁共识，你仍然可以继续做属于你个人权限范围内的探索，例如完成面试、确认薪资、了解地点与学校；真正需要共同决定的是那些会把共同现实正式改变的部分。

---

# 46. Customer Actions

允许：

```
Confirm decision owner
Split decision components
Add affected party
Mark consultation required
Request consent
Resolve ownership
Proceed with personal-authority step
Pause shared action
Request professional review
Continue
```

---

# 47. `status`

建议：

```
UNFORMED
PARTIAL
SOLE_AUTHORITY_CLEAR
SHARED_AUTHORITY_CLEAR
CONSENT_REQUIRED
CONSULTATION_REQUIRED
AUTHORITY_CONFLICT
AUTHORITY_UNRESOLVED
READY_FOR_ACTION_RUNTIME
REOPENED
```

---

# 48. Fail-Closed Conditions

以下情况不得进入 NAV-29：

```
decisionOwnerUnknown
sharedDecisionComponentNotSeparated
requiredConsentMissing
ownershipAssumed
thirdPartyPreferenceInvented
representativeAuthorityUnverified
affectedPartyIgnored
sharedMinimumIgnored
professionalAuthorityRequirementIgnored
symbolicReadingUsedAsAuthorityEvidence
```

---

# 49. Canonical Runtime Rule

> **Navigation must assign authority to the specific components of a shared decision rather than assume that one person either owns everything or owns nothing.**

中文：

> **Navigation 必须把决定权落实到共同决定中的具体组成部分，而不能假设一个人要么拥有全部决定权，要么完全没有决定权。**

---

# 50. Canonical Affected-Party Rule

> **Being affected creates relevance; it does not automatically create total decision authority.**

中文：

> **受到影响，会产生被纳入决定的现实相关性，却不会自动产生对整个决定的完全控制权。**

---

# 51. Canonical Agency Rule

> **Personal autonomy and shared responsibility can both be true at the same time.**

中文：

> **个人自主与共同责任可以同时成立，并不需要其中一方消灭另一方。**

---

# 52. Canonical Consent Rule

> **Consultation is not consent, and one person's account cannot provide consent for another.**

中文：

> **协商不是同意，一个人的叙述也不能替另一个人提供同意。**

---

# 53. Canonical Shared-Action Rule

> **When a shared action requires multiple legitimate authorities, decision sufficiency alone is not enough; the authority conditions must also be complete.**

中文：

> **当一个共同动作需要多个合法决定主体共同成立时，仅仅达到决策充分仍然不够，相关权威与同意条件也必须完整。**

---

# 54. Canonical No-Arbitration Rule

> **Navigation may clarify conflict, map rights and responsibilities, and structure the decision; it must not silently become the final arbiter between legitimate decision-makers.**

中文：

> **Navigation 可以澄清冲突、整理权利与责任并组织共同决定，却不能悄悄成为合法决定主体之间的最终裁判者。**

---

# 55. Final Canonical Form

```
NAV-28
SHARED AUTHORITY
```

**Input**

```
Decision Object
+
Specific Action
+
Decision Owners
+
Affected Parties
+
Ownership / Responsibility / Consent
```

**Process**

```
Split:
What belongs to one person?
What belongs to multiple people?
Who must be consulted?
Who must consent?
Who has formal authority?
Which parts may proceed independently?
```

**Output**

```
Shared Authority Map
+
Consent / Consultation State
+
Action Permission Boundary
```

**Boundary**

```
Affected does not equal owner.
Personal authority does not erase shared consequences.
Consultation does not equal consent.
Navigation does not arbitrate human lives.
```

modules.canonicalQuestion:
当一个决定已经达到足够充分、权威边界也已经清楚以后，
怎样让它真正进入现实，同时保留边界、观察、停止与修正能力？
modules.definition:
**Action Runtime** 是 Navigation 把已经通过 Decision Sufficiency、Impact / Reversibility Threshold 与 Shared Authority 的决定，转换成一个可以实际执行、被观察、被停止、被修正、并能够产生下一轮现实证据的行动结构。

它不是：

```
MAKE THE DECISION
```

也不是：

```
EXECUTE EVERYTHING AT ONCE
```

更不是：

```
recommendation → automatic action
```

它真正回答的是：

> **既然已经决定要向前，具体哪一步现在真正有资格进入现实；它以什么规模开始，持续多久，观察什么，什么条件会让它继续、暂停、缩小或退出？**

例如：

```
Decision:
逐步转向独立顾问工作
```

Action Runtime 不应该只输出：

```
Start consulting.
```

而应该形成：

```
Action:
启动 8 周有限客户试点

Scope:
最多 2 个客户

Resource:
每周不超过 8 小时

Financial exposure:
不增加固定债务

Observe:
客户获取
实际收入
时间负荷
家庭影响

Review:
第 4 周 / 第 8 周

Stop or redesign if:
违反既定现金底线
工作负荷超过确认边界
关键客户验证失败
```

因此：

> **NAV-29 的核心不是把分析变成命令，而是把一个已经取得资格的决定转化成有边界、可观察、可修正的现实行动。**

---
modules.navigationMeaning:
前 28 个模块主要回答：

```
What are we deciding?
Where are we?
What remains open?
What changes?
What matters?
What can we carry?
What can go wrong?
Who decides?
Do we know enough?
```

NAV-29 第一次正式回答：

```
What exactly happens next?
```

这一步非常重要。

因为一个决定如果没有转化成明确 Action Runtime，很容易出现三种漂移：

```
DECISION WITHOUT ACTION
ACTION WITHOUT BOUNDARY
ACTION WITHOUT OBSERVATION
```

第一种是：

> 想清楚了，但什么都没有发生。

第二种是：

> 决定只是先做一步，进入现实后却无限扩大。

第三种是：

> 行动发生了，却没有预先定义什么现实结果会让判断更新。

因此 NAV-29 建立：

```
Qualified Decision
+
Permitted Action Scale
+
Authority Boundary
↓
Concrete Action
↓
Scope / Time / Resources
↓
Observation
↓
Review / Trigger
↓
Continue / Adjust / Pause / Exit
```

---
modules.requiredInputs:
NAV-29 最低需要：

```
confirmedDecisionObject
selectedOrConfirmedDirection
decisionSufficiencyState
requiredDecisionThreshold
thresholdMetState
sharedAuthorityState
permittedActionScale
minimumAcceptableState
exitRecoveryState
```

如果没有明确：

```
what action is actually being taken
```

则不能进入 Action Runtime。

应标记：

```
ACTION_UNDEFINED
```

---
modules.optionalInputs:
```
currentPosition
timeAssessment
capacityQualificationState
waitingQualification
financialNavigationProjection
currentRealityProjection
professionalInput
legalOrContractualContext
relationshipContext
priorNavigationState
scenarioTriggers
```

这些用于决定：

- 行动什么时候开始；
- 行动规模；
- 资源上限；
- 观察指标；
- review point；
- 是否需要专业 handoff。

---
modules.inputAuthorityClasses:
允许：

```
USER_CONFIRMED_ACTION
SHARED_CONFIRMED_ACTION
FORMAL_AUTHORITY
PROFESSIONAL_REQUIREMENT
CURRENT_FACT
VERIFIED_RECORD
SUPPORTED_INFERENCE
SCENARIO_TRIGGER
INTERPRETIVE_CONTEXT
UNKNOWN
```

真正进入执行层的：

```
action
scope
consent
formal requirement
```

不能由：

```
Profile
BaZi
Zi Wei
Astrology
Tarot
I Ching
```

直接生成执行权。

---
modules.allowedInference:
NAV-29 可以：

## A. 把大决定转换成当前有资格的最小行动

例如：

```
Direction:
change career
```

而 NAV-27 只允许：

```
T1 / T2 action
```

则 NAV-29 可以形成：

```
apply
interview
pilot
course
short-term test
```

而不是直接：

```
resign
```

---

## B. 把 Action Scale 固定下来

例如：

```
pilot
```

必须进一步定义：

```
2 clients
8 weeks
max RM5k spend
max 8h/week
```

前提是这些边界有现实依据或由用户确认。

---

## C. 把已定义的 threshold 转成 runtime trigger

例如：

```
minimum liquidity floor
```

可以进入：

```
PAUSE / EXIT TRIGGER
```

但不能改变原 threshold。

---

## D. 建立 review point

例如：

```
review after 6 weeks
```

用于检查：

```
what changed
what did not
what new evidence appeared
```

---

## E. 识别行动已经扩大到超出原授权范围

例如：

原授权：

```
small pilot
```

实际运行变成：

```
full launch
```

系统可以标记：

```
ACTION_SCOPE_DRIFT
```

---
modules.forbiddenInference:
NAV-29 严禁：

## A. 把 recommendation 自动变成 execution

禁止：

```
PHI OS suggests X
→ automatically execute X
```

---

## B. 在用户未确认时扩大 Action Scale

禁止：

```
pilot succeeded
→ full rollout automatically
```

---

## C. 忽略原 authority boundary

例如：

```
research approved
```

不代表：

```
sign contract approved
```

---

## D. 用 symbolic input 触发执行动作

禁止：

```
Tarot says go
→ begin action
```

---

## E. 因为早期结果好就取消停止条件

```
good early result
≠
exit rules no longer matter
```

---

## F. 把 Action Runtime 变成无期限习惯

每个重大 action 应有：

```
review point
trigger
or completion condition
```

---

NAV-29 主要影响：

```
ACTION_START

ACTION_BOUNDARY
MONITORING_REQUIREMENT
PAUSE_STATE
EXIT_STATE

```

modules.decisionThresholdEffect:
NAV-29 不重新计算 NAV-27 的 threshold。

它负责确保：

```
actual action scale
<=
```

canonicalSections.heading: `canonicalQuestion`
canonicalSections.body:
```
当一个决定已经达到足够充分、权威边界也已经清楚以后，
怎样让它真正进入现实，同时保留边界、观察、停止与修正能力？
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: `definition`
canonicalSections.body:
**Action Runtime** 是 Navigation 把已经通过 Decision Sufficiency、Impact / Reversibility Threshold 与 Shared Authority 的决定，转换成一个可以实际执行、被观察、被停止、被修正、并能够产生下一轮现实证据的行动结构。

它不是：

```
MAKE THE DECISION
```

也不是：

```
EXECUTE EVERYTHING AT ONCE
```

更不是：

```
recommendation → automatic action
```

它真正回答的是：

> **既然已经决定要向前，具体哪一步现在真正有资格进入现实；它以什么规模开始，持续多久，观察什么，什么条件会让它继续、暂停、缩小或退出？**

例如：

```
Decision:
逐步转向独立顾问工作
```

Action Runtime 不应该只输出：

```
Start consulting.
```

而应该形成：

```
Action:
启动 8 周有限客户试点

Scope:
最多 2 个客户

Resource:
每周不超过 8 小时

Financial exposure:
不增加固定债务

Observe:
客户获取
实际收入
时间负荷
家庭影响

Review:
第 4 周 / 第 8 周

Stop or redesign if:
违反既定现金底线
工作负荷超过确认边界
关键客户验证失败
```

因此：

> **NAV-29 的核心不是把分析变成命令，而是把一个已经取得资格的决定转化成有边界、可观察、可修正的现实行动。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: `navigationMeaning`
canonicalSections.body:
前 28 个模块主要回答：

```
What are we deciding?
Where are we?
What remains open?
What changes?
What matters?
What can we carry?
What can go wrong?
Who decides?
Do we know enough?
```

NAV-29 第一次正式回答：

```
What exactly happens next?
```

这一步非常重要。

因为一个决定如果没有转化成明确 Action Runtime，很容易出现三种漂移：

```
DECISION WITHOUT ACTION
ACTION WITHOUT BOUNDARY
ACTION WITHOUT OBSERVATION
```

第一种是：

> 想清楚了，但什么都没有发生。

第二种是：

> 决定只是先做一步，进入现实后却无限扩大。

第三种是：

> 行动发生了，却没有预先定义什么现实结果会让判断更新。

因此 NAV-29 建立：

```
Qualified Decision
+
Permitted Action Scale
+
Authority Boundary
↓
Concrete Action
↓
Scope / Time / Resources
↓
Observation
↓
Review / Trigger
↓
Continue / Adjust / Pause / Exit
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: `requiredInputs`
canonicalSections.body:
NAV-29 最低需要：

```
confirmedDecisionObject
selectedOrConfirmedDirection
decisionSufficiencyState
requiredDecisionThreshold
thresholdMetState
sharedAuthorityState
permittedActionScale
minimumAcceptableState
exitRecoveryState
```

如果没有明确：

```

```

则不能进入 Action Runtime。

应标记：

```
ACTION_UNDEFINED
```


这些用于决定：

- 行动什么时候开始；
- 行动规模；
- 资源上限；
- 观察指标；
- review point；
- 是否需要专业 handoff。

canonicalSections.body:
允许：

```

```

不能由：


直接生成执行权。

canonicalSections.heading: Core Action Runtime States
canonicalSections.body:
建议至少区分：

```
ACTION_NOT_READY
ACTION_READY
ACTION_ACTIVE
ACTION_ACTIVE_WITH_MONITORING
ACTION_PAUSED
ACTION_ADJUSTMENT_REQUIRED
ACTION_SCALE_REDUCTION_REQUIRED
EXIT_TRIGGER_REACHED
ACTION_COMPLETED
ACTION_OUTCOME_PENDING_REVIEW
```

---

## A. `ACTION_NOT_READY`

虽然方向可能已确认，但：

```
threshold
authority
consent
scope
```

仍有缺口。

---

## B. `ACTION_READY`

行动已经满足当前规模所需条件，可以进入现实。

---

## C. `ACTION_ACTIVE`

行动已经开始，正在现实中运行。

---

## D. `ACTION_ACTIVE_WITH_MONITORING`

行动继续，但某些边界已经接近 review threshold。

---

## E. `ACTION_PAUSED`

暂时停止继续扩展，不等于整个方向被放弃。

---

## F. `ACTION_ADJUSTMENT_REQUIRED`

现实反馈显示行动方式需要修改。

---

## G. `ACTION_SCALE_REDUCTION_REQUIRED`

当前方向未必失效，但原规模超过现实承载能力。

---

## H. `EXIT_TRIGGER_REACHED`

NAV-25 已定义的退出条件真实发生。

这时必须重新进入：

```
Exit / Recovery Runtime
```

而不是继续解释为什么“也许再坚持一下”。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Core Action Components
canonicalSections.body:
每个 Action Runtime 至少应该定义：

```
ACTION
SCOPE
START
DURATION_OR_REVIEW_POINT
RESOURCE_BOUNDARY
AUTHORITY_BOUNDARY
OBSERVATION_SET
CONTINUE_TRIGGER
ADJUST_TRIGGER
PAUSE_TRIGGER
EXIT_TRIGGER
OUTCOME_CAPTURE
```

canonicalSections.heading: `allowedInference`
canonicalSections.body:
NAV-29 可以：

## A. 把大决定转换成当前有资格的最小行动

例如：

```
Direction:
change career
```

而 NAV-27 只允许：

```
T1 / T2 action
```

则 NAV-29 可以形成：

```
apply
interview
pilot
course
short-term test
```

而不是直接：

```
resign
```

---

## B. 把 Action Scale 固定下来

例如：

```
pilot
```

必须进一步定义：

```
2 clients
8 weeks
max RM5k spend
max 8h/week
```

前提是这些边界有现实依据或由用户确认。

---

## C. 把已定义的 threshold 转成 runtime trigger

例如：

```
minimum liquidity floor
```

可以进入：

```
PAUSE / EXIT TRIGGER
```

但不能改变原 threshold。

---

## D. 建立 review point

例如：

```
review after 6 weeks
```

用于检查：

```
what changed
what did not
what new evidence appeared
```

---

## E. 识别行动已经扩大到超出原授权范围

例如：

原授权：

```
small pilot
```

实际运行变成：

```
full launch
```

系统可以标记：

```
ACTION_SCOPE_DRIFT
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: `forbiddenInference`
canonicalSections.body:
NAV-29 严禁：

## A. 把 recommendation 自动变成 execution

禁止：

```
PHI OS suggests X
→ automatically execute X
```

---

## B. 在用户未确认时扩大 Action Scale

禁止：

```
pilot succeeded
→ full rollout automatically
```

---

## C. 忽略原 authority boundary

例如：

```
research approved
```

不代表：

```
sign contract approved
```

---

## D. 用 symbolic input 触发执行动作

禁止：

```
Tarot says go
→ begin action
```

---

## E. 因为早期结果好就取消停止条件

```
good early result
≠
exit rules no longer matter
```

---

## F. 把 Action Runtime 变成无期限习惯

每个重大 action 应有：

```
review point
trigger
or completion condition
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Canonical Action Runtime Model
canonicalSections.body:
建议：

```
{
  "actionRuntimeId": "",
  "decisionObjectId": "",
  "actionId": "",
  "actionDescription": "",
  "actionScale": "",
  "startState": "",
  "scope": [],
  "resourceLimits": [],
  "authorityRequirements": [],
  "observationSet": [],
  "reviewPoints": [],
  "continueTriggers": [],
  "adjustTriggers": [],
  "pauseTriggers": [],
  "exitTriggers": [],
  "outcomes": [],
  "status": ""
}
```
